question: Mu somo ly'Essomabiramu, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa kino eri Ekibiina ekisooka: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo." Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera obumanyirivu bw'abayizi?
answer_a: Bawe olupapula olwereere era abayizi obagambe okukuba omuti gw'ekibala ky'asinga okwagala mu biseera by'omwaka bibiri.
answer_b: Laga ebifaananyi by'emiti egy'enjawulo era obuuze abayizi okugyawulamu egyo egibala n'egitabala.
answer_c: Waayo olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emiti gy'ebibala, nga buli gumu guliko ekiseera kye gubaliramu, era obasabe okugisiiga langi.
answer_d: Waayo kaadi eziriko emiti egy'enjawulo n'endala eziriko ebibala era obuuze abayizi okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala ekiguliko.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Omusomesa anyonyola abaana enkukakyuka amazzi gye gayitamu.Mbeera ki wammanga eyinza okukozesebwa nga ekyokulabirako nti omukka gufuuka amazzi?
answer_a: Omuzira okugwa ku mazzi go mugga

answer_c: Amazzi gomugga okunyogoga negafuuka bbalaafu

answer_a: Omuyaga
answer_b: Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi
answer_c: Enjawulo mu bwoki bw’omu bbanga
answer_d: Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'abaana abato, Ignacio ayanjula ku ky'ekyennyanja ekya clownfish eraannyonnyola bagenzi be nti ekika kino kifuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja okulwanyisa abalya ebyennyanja ebirala, ate era n'ettooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga ekyennyanja kigoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya. Omusomesa ayingirawo okubannyonnyola erinnya ly'ekika ky'enkolagana y'ebiramu ekyogeddwaako omwana. Nkola ki ey'enkolagana y'ebiramu omusomesa gy'asaanidde okwogerako mu kunnyonnyola kwe?
answer_a: Obuwangwa obw’okubeera awamu nga ekimu ku biramu kiganyulwa ate ekirala tekirina kye kifuna wadde okufiirwa.
answer_b: Amensalism kitegeeza omukwano wakati w'ebiriwo ebimu gye kiremesa ekirala so nga kyo tekirina kye kifiirwa.
answer_c: Obutalina ludda lwe bayimiriddeko
answer_d: Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu

question: Omusomesa akoze emirimu gino wammanga ku kitundu eky’okuyiga ekikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba: 1. Abayizi basoma era neekebejja ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba ey’omulembe n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu. 2. Abayizi bakola ku bizibu ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba n’ebintu ebigirimu, n’enteekateeka y’amasannyalaze, n’ennamba za kwantaamu. 3. Abayizi bakubaganya ebirowoozo mu bibinja ku biwandiiko ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu ndabika y’akaziba n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu nga balina ebifaananyi ebigyoleka (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Abayizi bakola okugeraageranya ku ndabika z’akaziba ez’enjawulo nga booleka ebipimo byazo ebikulu. Mu nteekateeka zino wammanga, engeri ki esinga okukubiriza okuyiga okutondekawo okutegeera okw’amaanyi ku ndabika y’akaziba?

Mu kwekkeneenya mu bufunze, omusomesa w'ebiramu ayogera ekibuuzo kino wammanga: Nkyukakyuka kimu mubiri eziyinza okuzuula mu mukazi eyaweebwa eddagala okuyimiriza ekikolwa kya GnHR? Zinnyonyole. Kwekkeneenya ki wammanga okugoberera ebiraga okukolebwa ekintu ekitegekeddwa?
answer_a: Omulimu gw'obuwangwa oguleeta enkyukakyuka mu buvubuka.
answer_b: Nnyonnyola engeri omutwe gw’obwongo gye gufugaamu omusinde gw’eb激素 eziva mu kitundu kya hypothalamus ku musinde gw’ebisa eggi n’omubiri gw’ennyingo.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’ekizadde ng’okozesa omutendera gw’obuwulukuto, okuva kw’eggimu, n’omutendera gwa luteal.
answer_d: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’omubiri gw’ekyenda nga bikwatagana n’okukyenga omusaayi, ekiseera eky’okukula, n’ekiseera eky’okukola ebintu.

question: Mu kitundu "Amaanyi G'amasannyalaze n'Emigugu gy'amasannyalaze" mu kibiina ekya kkumi na bibiri, omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika. Mu mbeera y'etteeka lya Ohm, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisaana okukozesebwa ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Abayizi bakola eggulaafu eraga amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agavaamu (current intensity) okusinzira ku voltisi mu sikito entuufu, nga balowooza nti obuzibu (resistance) bwa nkalakkalira.
answer_b: Abayizi bakola ggulaafu okuva mu mmeeza erimu ebipimo by'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agayita mu waya ku buli voltisi, oluvannyuma ne baginnyonnyola.
answer_c: Abayizi bakkaanya ku buzibu bw'ebintu ebikulembera amasannyalaze; buli omu aweebwa omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze n'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze nga bipimiddwa mu nkola.
answer_d: Abayizi baweebwa ebipimo by'amasannyalaze ebitali bifaanagana ne bakakasa, nga bayisaawo omugatte gw'amasannyalaze agasaliddwa ku buli kimu, oba ng'ekipimo ky'amasannyalaze ekyatuukirizibwa omukolezi kituufu.

question: Nsomesa yakikula ki esanidde okuwa abayizi okusobola okutandikawo okusobola okutegeera sayansi wa radioactive series?

answer_b: Ensibuko y'obutoffaali bw'ebintu
answer_c: Enkula ya atom okusinzira ku nsengeka ya electrons
answer_d: Obutofaali bw'ebintu ne bunabwo bwebufanagana

question: Kumanya ki okusooka okwetaagisa abayizi okukola ku ndowooza ya VSEPR mu molekyo ez'enjawulo?
answer_a: Omugatte gw'akanyigirizi ka dipole oguvaamu molekyu ez'enjawulo
answer_b: Eteeka lya duet ne octet ku nkola y'obuziba.
answer_c: Okukiikirira empandiika z'ebisengeke bya kemiko ebiri mu molekyuulu
answer_d: Akakodyo ka valence shell electron pair repulsion (VSEPR) nga kakozesebwa ku molekyu ez'enjawulo.

question: Mu kiseera ky’ekibiina ku nkola enkulu eza obutaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko mu makolero, pulofeesa ayogera ku butaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko obutundibwa obuyitibwa akataffaali ka Downs, akasobozesa okufuna sodiyamu ow’ekyuma nga tuyita mu kuyabuluza omunnyo gwa sodiyamu kkalolayidi (NaCl) oguyengeddwa. Ku bino ebikulu wammanga, kiki ekisobola okulabwa mu kiseera akataffaali ka Downs we kakolera?
answer_a: Sodiyamu ey’ekyuma eterekebwa ku anode olw’okukendeeza kwa ayoni za sodiyamu
answer_b: Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa ku cathode okuyita mu oxidation ya chloride ions.
answer_c: Ayoni za kkalolayidi zigenda ku anode okwoksidizibwa
answer_d: Obutaffaali bwa sodium butambula okudda ku cathode olw'enkendeeza yaabwo.

question: Omusomesa alimu kukola ebyokuyiga ku nkula y'ensi n'abaana be ab'ekibiina ekyokuna, ayagala okulaga ebika bya obububi ebikola ensi nga akozesa ekintu ekyabulijjo. Bintu ki ku bino wamanga ebisobola okozesebwa okuwa entadikwa ennungi ku kigenda okusomesebwa?
answer_a: Eggi eli kaluba nga fumbe
answer_b: Kadole ka Russia akalimu budole obulala
answer_c: Ebibala ebirimu ebitundu tundu
answer_d: Akapiira ak'ebbombo

question: Omusomesa yateekawo ekibuuzo kino mu kigezo ky'ebikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu: “Omubiri gutambula okusinziira ku kibalangulo kino: x=25+40t−5t2 (nga t ali mu sikonda ate x ali mu mita). Omubiri gunaaba gutambudde mita mmeka nga wayiseewo 5 s ne 6 s?” Bw’amaze okukebera eby’okuddamu, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi be tebakimanyi nti, okusinziira ku by’okuddamu byabwe, omubiri guba gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu, kubanga abasinga obungi baddamu nti omubiri gutambudde mita 100 mu sikonda 5 ate mita 85 mu sikonda 6. Ku ngeri eziri wammanga, engeri ki esinga okuba nga yaleetera abayizi abasinga obungi okuzibuwalirwa?
answer_a: Obuzibu obuli mu kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bibuuzo bya kinemaatika
answer_b: Obutabaawo kwetendeka mu kumanya ebintu ebirambiddwa n'okukozesa ennyingo ezisaana.
answer_c: Okuteebereza okutali kukkufu ku nsonga ezitali nnamba eziva mu bibuuzo bya kinemattika.
answer_d: Obunafu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kubala okusobola okwaŋŋanga okugonjoola ebizibu bya kinemattika

question: Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olutalo olulaga omulandira ogutandikira ku birowoozo ebya bulijjo okudda ku birowoozo ebikalu ennyo?

Mu mutendera gw'essomo "akaziba n'obuziizi bwako," omusomesa asaba abayizi be ab'omwaka ogw'okuna mu siniya okukola omulimu guno: "Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku makulu g'okuyiga ku buzziizi bwa akaziba n'engeri gye buyinza okukozesebwa mu tekinologiya, nga mulowooza ku ky'okuba nti, okuva ku ebyo ebibeerawo mu buzziizi bwa atomu obw'ebintu ebimu, kisoboka okufuna amasannyalaze era n'okukulaakulanya tekinologiya asobola okuganyula abantu. Naddala, mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ky'okuzimba amasannyalaze ga nukiriya mu ggwanga lyaffe okusobola okukola amasannyalaze." Kigendererwa ki eky'okusoma ekisobola okutuukibwako nga omulimu ogusabiddwa gukoleddwa?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola enkula y'akaziba n'obuziizi bwako, ng'otegeera enjawulo wakati w'ebintu eby'enjawulo n'obuziba bwabyo, n'empalirizo ezisookerwako ezizingirwamu, wamu n’amaanyi ag’omusingi agalimu.
answer_b: Yamba abayizi okutegeera obuziba bw'akaziba n'obuziizi bwako, n'okutegeera emirimu gy'abasayansi b'obuziizi
answer_c: Kubiriza abayizi okwagala okukwataganya  n'okusoma kw'obuziba n'enkozesa yabyo mu tekinologiya ne mubulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_d: Kulaakulanya mu bayizi obusobozi okunnyonnyola engeri amasoboza(amaanyi) gye gafunibwa okuva mu buziizi bwa atomu n'engeri amasoboza(amaanyi) gano gye gayinza okufuulibwamu amasannyalaze.

question: Ku sitaamenti zino wammanga eriwa erina endowooza enkyamu abayizi gye balina ekwata ku kwekolako mu nkola ya sayansi w'amasoboza(thermadynamic processes)?
answer_a: Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.
answer_b: Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.
answer_c: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.
answer_d: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n’okusaasaanya amasoboza.

question:
Omusomesa ayagala ekibiina kye okumanya etteeka lya Hund erikwata ku bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo.
Kati ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku gyo gwe gwandisinze okulaga obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Okuwandiika endagiriro z'amasannyalaza ag'ensi yonna ez'atomi ez'enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera ey'ettaka.
answer_b: Okuwandiika empandiika enfunze eyebyamasenyalaze  ez’enjawulo mu atomu nga ziri mu mbeera ey’obutebenkevu.
answer_c: Okugeraageranya okusaasanya kw'obusannyalaza mu bifananyi  ebyekusa okwetoloola akakungulu k'amasannyalaze agali ku ngulu mu atomu ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okugerageranya endabika y'kungulu  y’amasannyalaze ag’ebweru aga atomu ez’enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera eya bulijjo n’eya kusisimuka.

question: Mu kibiina eky'omunaana, mu kitundu ekikwata ku butonde bw'ekintu, omusomesa abasomesa ku butonde bw'akaziba. Okukakasa oba ng'abayizi bategedde enjawulo eri wakati w'omuwendo gw'akaziba n'omuwendo gw'ekintu, abasaba okulaga omuwendo gwa konta, obusannyalazo, n'obutonniinya obuli mu atomu ya aluminiamu, ng'ate aluminiamu alina omuwendo gw'akaziba 13 n'omuwendo gw'ekintu 27. Abayizi abawerako balaga bwe bati: Aluminiamu alina obusannyalazo 27, konta 13, n'obutonniinya 14. Kusoomooza ki abayizi kwe boolekagana nakwo mu kuyiga kwabwe okukwata ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Okukkiriza nti omuwendo gwa elekitooni gwenkanankana n'omuwendo gwa konta ne nampawengwa.
answer_b: Nga tebategedde nti namba y'akaziba etambulira wamu n'omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze ag'ekika kya pozitiivu
answer_c: Okukkiriza nti namba y'obuzito etegereza omuwendo gwa chaji eri positivu ne negativu
answer_d: Obutamanya nti omuwendo gw'obusannyalazo gwenkanankana n'omuwendo gw'obusannyalazo obw'ekibogwe n'obw'ekisannyalazo.

question:
Omusomesa ategekera ekibiina ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogwokusatu mu siniya, ng'ekigendererwa kyabwe kiri "Okutegeera empewozeso eya sentripeta n'amaanyi ga sentripeta ng'ebireetera ekintu okutambula mu ngeri ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi". Mu kumanya okukulembedde kuno okukwata ku 
buwuka kuki abayizi kwe bateekwa okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera amaanyi ga sentripeta bwe gakola ku ntambula y'omubiri mu ntambula ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi?
answer_a: Okuggyako vekita
answer_b: Okugataganya enzala yobuwuka
answer_c: Omugatte gwa 'dot' wakati wobuwuka
answer_d: Okutondeesa obuwuka nga tukozesa ebipimo bya Katisiyaani

question: Biteeso byabayizzi ki wammanga ebi bayamba okuyiga omusingi gwa Archimedes?
answer_a: okulowooza nti puleesa y'omubbanga tekosa puleesa eretebwa amazzi
answer_b: Okulowooza nti obuwanvu bwa mazzi ekintu mwe kigudde buki kaka okunyigibwa amazzi
answer_c: Okulowooza nti puleesa enyiga omubiri ogubbide mu mazzi ku sinziira ku buwanvu bw'ago
answer_d: Okulowooza nti puleesa ya mazzi enyiga wansi wa konteyina nti esinziira ku nkula ya konteyina

question:
Omusomesa omukulu mu ssomero lya siniya ayagala abayizi be okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebizingirwa mu kuzuula ebbanga ery'ekitundu ery'obulamu bw'ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu.
Kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okusobozesa abayizi okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Kuba ekifaananyi ekiraga okuvunda kw'ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu
answer_b: Teekawo ekiteeberezo ku kuvunda kwa nukiriya(obuziizi) okuva mu kintu ekifulumya olubugumu
answer_c: Kozesa obubaka okuva mu kipimo ky’ekiseera n’ekigero ky’obungi bw’ekintu ekifulumizibwa okuva mu kintu ekirina obutaffaali obw’ekika ekimu
answer_d: Koppa(geegenya) okuvunda kw’ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu era olabe omuwendo gw’obutaffaali obuvunda

question:
Omusomesa w’essomero lya siniya mu mwaka ogusooka, mu somo lya Stoichiometry yeetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw’abayizi u kipimo kya Stoichiometry mu mwenkanonkano gwa kemiko ogw'enkanankana..
Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okuteesa okukakasa okuyiga okwatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Bala omuwendo gw'ekipimo ky'akazimbulukusa wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu mu kikolwa.
answer_b: Bala obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu era okakase omukwano(gw'okubala) oguli wakati waabyo mu kubala.
answer_c: Zimba emmeeza (olukalala)  elaga obwenkanankana wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu, n'omuwendo gwabyo ku buli kikumi.
answer_d: Zimba emmeeza(olukalala) elaga obwenkanankana wakati wa mole, molekyu, n'obuziba, okusinziira ku bintu ebiri mu kikyusabuziba

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza okunnyonnyola omulimu gw’ebitundu by’obutoffaali mu butoffaali bwa kika kya eukaryotic, omusomesa agenda kwongera okunnyonnyola omulimu gwabyo ng’akozesa olugero olufaananya ebyuma n’ebitundu by’ekkolero ku butoffaali. answer_a: Masiini ekyusa ebinytu byobulamu okubifuula amaanyi.

question: Mu kwekkeneenya mu bufunze, omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'omunaana ategese okwekeneenya ekigendererwa kino wammanga: "Nnyonyola ebiteeberezebwa ku gisomyo bya Dalton ebikwatagana n'obuziba bw'obuntu." Kwekkeneenya ki okulagiddwa wammanga ogunasobozesa abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo.
answer_b: Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw’obungi bw’obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky’ekemiko.

answer_d: Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu.

question: Omusomesa owa siniya ey'okuna ateekateeka essomo erigendereddwa okuyamba abayizi okutegeera omugaso gw’okugemesa mu by’obulamu bw’abantu bonna. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga ekiyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino okutambulira wamu n’endagaano y’ebiri mu syllabus ekwata ku kumanya okw’ekisaayansi?
answer_a: Ba vunula ebitukuukawo nga okugema kuwedde , okusinzira ku ngezesa enkadde nga eya Edward Jenner
answer_b: Betegeleza, nga basinziira ku chaati, obungi bw’endwadde ezimu ezisiigala era ne bateebereza ebireeta obungi obwo.
answer_c: Bageraageranya, nga basinziira ku chaati, omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa ne bagukwataganya n'okusaanyizibwawo n'okukomawo  kw'endwadde ezimu.
answer_d: Bazimba olukalala lw'ebikulu ebyatuukiddwaako mu nkola y'okugema, nga balaga omukono gw'abasaayansi abaatandikawo omulimu guno.

question: Mu kibiina kya siniya esooka, abayizi beenyigira mu bikolwa ebikwaata ku ngeri ebifaananyi gye bikolebwamu mu ndabirwamu engolole ne mu ndabirwamu empete. Mu kiseera ky’ekikolwa, omuyizi agolola omukono gwe waggulu n’agamba: "Musomesa, era sitegeera njawulo eri wakati w’ebifaananyi ebituufu n’ebifaananyi ebyaddala n'ebitali byadaala, ne lwaki biyitibwa bwebityo." Kunyonyola ki omusomesa kw’anaakozesa okutangaaza okutabulwatabulwa kw’omuyizi, ng’addamu mu ngeri etegeerekeka era n’obwegendereza obukulu ku kibuzo kye?
answer_a: Laba ku ludda olumu n'olulala olw'ekijiiko. Ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga bw'oli ddala sikituufu ate ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga kikyuse kiba kituufu.
answer_b: Olina okujjikira nti ebifaananyi ebituufu bulijjo biba byesulise okuva waggulu okudda wansi, ate ng’ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bulijjo biba bitereevu.
answer_c: Ebifaananyi ebitali byaddala birabika ng'ebikolebwa emabega w'endabirwamu, ate nga ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa mu maaso gaayo era bisobola okukubibwa ku lutimbe.
answer_d: Ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bikolebwa mu kifo eky’obulimba ekireetera emiryango gy’omusana okugaziwa, ate ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa okuyita mu kulagula emiryango gy’omusana egidda waggulu.

question: Omusomesa owa siniya ey'okubiri,mu kitundu kya Kinematics, ajja kukola okwekaliriza okuzuula okutegeera kw'abayizi ku kuva kw'ebintu mu kugwa. Okusinziira ku kigendererwa kino, kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okuzuula obulungi okumanya kw'abayizi ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Mu kifo ky'ebweru, basuula ebintu eby'enjawulo waggulu era ne bageraageranya ebipimo bya buli kusuula.
answer_b: Baddamu ebibuuzo ebigendereddwa okugeraageranya n'okusuubira obungi bw'ebiseera ebyetaagisa ebintu eby'enjawulo okugwa okuva waggulu obuwunzifu.
answer_c: Balaga mu kifaananyi obwolekero bw'okwongeza sipiidi y'omupiira gwa ttena nga guli mu bbanga okuva ku muzannyi omu okudda ku mulala.
answer_d: Bakola mmaapu eraga engeri ebintu gye bitambulamu mu bwengula.

question: Omusomesa was siniya ali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri, mu kitundu kya 'sterochemistry' ne 'isomerism' ategekera ekibiina n'ekigenderwa eky'okuyiga wammanga"Okuzuula omugaso gwa R ne S ensengeka y'ekirungo ekigatta ekikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Ku mirimu egiweereddwa wammanga guliwa ogunakola n'ekigenderwa ekiteeseddwako n'abayizi?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okufumiitiriza ku makulu g'ebyenfuna agali mu kukola eddagala eririna ebika bya R ne S.
answer_b: Buuza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bintu ebibaawo ku bulamu bw’omuntu ng’akozesa eddagala ebbiri eriri mu ngeri ya enantiomers.
answer_c: Buuza abayizi okugeraageranya obuwangwa bw’ebintu ebirungo obwa R ne S stereoisomer obw’ebintu ebikozesebwa ennyo 5, gamba nga, ibuprofen
answer_d: Baagalire abayizi okukozesa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog okusalawo endagakubbo ya R ne S eya kampawundi 5 ezikozesebwa ennyo, ng'ekyokulabirako, frukitoosi.

question: Mu kibiina kya glued 8, omusomesa akoze ekigezo ku kaziba n’engeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu. Ebivaamu biraga nti omuwendo munene ogw’abayizi balowooza nti okukolebwa kwa keyoni (cations) kuleetebwawo atomu okwongerako oba “okufuna” polotooni (protons). Mulimu ki omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi be okubayamba okutegeera obulungi engeri keyoni gye zikolebwamu?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okutegeera omuwendo gwa pulotoni, erikitulooni, ne nyutulooni eziri mu ayoni ez’enjawulo nga basinziira ku namba y’akaziba (Z) n’ennamba y’obuzito (A).
answer_b: Basabye abayizi okukola, awamu n'omusomesa, emmeza elaga omuwendo gwa pulotoni, erekutulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu katayoni ne anayoni ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Saba abayizi okukola ekibalanguwa ekiraga engeri emiramwa gino gye gikwatagana: akaziba, olububi, obusannyalaza, obukontanyo,obutaffaali, ayoni, kayoni, n’ayoni enkyamu
answer_d: Bayizi balambike okugeraageranya engeri atomu ya sodium entaanu gy'efaanana n'engeri sodium bw'efaanana ng'ekyebulukusi, nga balowooza ku muwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nyutulooni eza buli emu.

question: Omusomesa, mu mwaka ogusooka ogwa Siniya, mu mutwe gw'eky'obulamu ogw'Enkyukakyuka n'Obungi bw'ebiramu, akola omulimu n'abayizi be mwe balina okugeraageranya amino asidi ez'enjawulo eza puloteni C okuva mu bisolo eby'enjawulo n'okuteebereza enkolagana y'eby'obusika wakati waazo. Mu kiseera ky'okukola omulimu guno, omuyizi abuuza: “Bwe kiba nti ekisukkulumya ebiramu kwe kuba n'amawulire mu DNA yaabyo, mugaso ki ogw'okugeraageranya ennyiriri za amino asidi eza puloteni?”. Nga tutunuulidde omutendera gw'omuyizi, mu nnyonnyola zino omusomesa gy'awa, eyiwa ku kibuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okweyoleka mu biramu by’ebika eby’enjawulo. Amawulire agazimba ekizimbamubiri ago galondoolwa mu busirikale bw’obutonde (genes). N’olwekyo, okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo wakati w’obusirikale bw’obutonde obukola ekizimbamubiri n’olukalala lw’ebitundu by’ekizimbamubiri (amino acid sequences), enkolagana z’emyaka gy’obulamu wakati w’ebika bisobola okuteeberezebwa.
answer_b: Protein zikolebwa mu nnyiriri za amino acids ezitegekebwa mu DNA. Bwe wabaawo enkyukakyuka mu kino, kijja kukyusa ennyiriri za amino acids ez'ekirungo ekyo. N'olwekyo, okusinziira ku muwendo gwa amino acids ez'enjawulo ez'ekirungo kye kimu, omuntu asobola okumanya engeri ebika ebibiri gye bikwataganamu mu ngeri y'obuzaale.
answer_c: Puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu kunnyonnyolwa kw’obubaka bwa RNA, obuva mu kuwandiika kwa jjiini. Puloteni eno esobola okulagibwa nga waliwo enkyukakyuka mu nkola y’obusirikale bw’amino asidi. N’olwekyo, nga tukozesa okunoonyereza ku nkola zino, enkolagana z’endabika y’ebiramu ez’enjawulo zisobola okuteekebwawo.
answer_d: Ennyiriri za amino acid ez’ekizimbamubiri zisalibwawo ennyiriri za codons eziba mu mRNA okuva mwe kikolebwa. Okuva buli codon bw’ekwatagana n’ennyiriri za nucleotides essatu, bwe kikyusibwa, ekizimbamubiri ekirimu amino acid ez’enjawulo ku ezo ez’ekizimbamubiri ekisooka kisobola okufunibwa. N’olwekyo, okumanya omuwendo gwa amino acids ez’enjawulo wakati w’ebika ebibiri, omuntu asobola okumanya engeri gye byekuusiza ku kika ekirala mu ngeri y’okukula.

question: Omusomesa wa sekendule,mu kusoma kwomwaaka ogwokubiri, mu kiseera ky’essomo ku DNA oba ndaga butondde  n’okukubisaamu obutaffaali, ateekateeka  omulimu gw’okukolera ku kisomebwaako kino kino: “Okutegeera engeri ebizimba bya kookolo gye bikolebwa”. Magezi ki abayizi ge beetaaga okuba nga bamaze okubimanya okusobola okukola ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Ebiseera by'emitendera gw'enkula  yakataffaali
answer_b: Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosisi
answer_c: Ebifo ebikeberwamu ku nkula neneeyisa yobutaffaali
answer_d: Ebika byokwekubisaamu mu DNA oba ndagabutondde ne mu chromosome

question: Omusomesa wa sekondale yetegeka okugenda okusomesa ekibiina ekyo kubiri wana vummurira bino wammamnga:"Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale".Mirimu ki wammanga egiyamba omuyizzi okukola ebiteeseddwa?
answer_a: Bawe ebyokulabirako byo kutomeregana kwo'mutindo ogwamaanyi gye gukuumibwa
answer_b: Ba pima obuzito ne misiinde gye mmotoka nga zitomeregana kuluguudo no'ku kalabulwa
answer_c: Bye bisalawo enkolagana wakati wo'kukaka okuteekebbwawo,obudde bwetekeddwa wo, nentunnunsi omubiri gwe zifuna mu ludda olumu
answer_d: Bisuubira nti alizaati zo kutomeregana wakati wa ma bulooka agafaanagana gaseerera ewatali kwekuutiza

question: Omusomesa omubisi omwaka ogusooka mu Ssekendulewa ateekateeka essomo n’ekigendererwa kino: “Okukozesa omutindo gw’amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka era ne kimenyeka bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri.” Ng’enkola y’okuyigiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino, omusomesa asalawo okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby’okusomesa ebyanguya okutegeera ebyo ebiri mu somo. Kiki ku bikozesebwa eby’okusomesa wammanga ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’omusomesa kino?
answer_a: Ekitundu ky’ekitabo ky’essomero ekinnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’endowooza y’obuntu n’ey’amayengo ku musana, n’obubaka buli emu bwe yawa ku misinde gy’omusana mu kubulukuka.
answer_b: Okutengejja okw’ekikompyuta okulaga mu bujjuvu engeri ebyoya by’omusaayi gw’amazzi gye bikosebwa olw’okukyusa n’okumenyeka kw’ekitangaala nga kikuba ekifo wakati w’ebintu bibiri
answer_c: Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza nga gukuba amazzi agali mu akuliyamu, we kiyinza okulabirwa nti ekitundu ku mutangaavu guddamu waggulu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kimenyeka ku mpalazo engeri engeri.
answer_d: Omulimu ogukolebwa ku kompyuta ogusobozesa omuyizi okulaba nga omutangaavu bwe gutumizibwa ku kintu ekigabanya ebintu bibiri eby’enjawulo, ekitundu kimu kiguddamu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kiyitamu nga buli kimu kirina engeli yakyo.

question: Ekimu ku bigendererwa abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya bye bakolerako kwe "kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola obubaka(data) obukwata ku ngeri ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo gye bikolamu."Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe guleka omuntu okukebereza ekigendererwa ekyo waggulu?
answer_a: Wa abayizi obubaka(data) obukwata ku amafuta kwe gatandikira okwesera era obabuuze okwekenneenya oba gaba gakwafu, gakulukusi oba ga ggaasi ku tempulikya y'ekisenge.
answer_b: Saba abayizi okunoonyereza ku bubonero bw’okubulukuka kw’ebinywamaji bya kaboni eby’obuwanvu obwenjawulo, babitegeke mu mmeeza, era balambulule oba biri mu mbeera ya kikalu, kikulukusi, oba ggaasi ku tempulikya eya bulijjo.
answer_c: Wa abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokirokaboni ze zibulira ku buwanvu bw'enziringanya ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu tebuleni era obasabe okunnyonnyola empisa okusinziira ku mikwanaganyo egireeteddwa molekyuulu.
answer_d: Wa abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokola bwa haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo, ze balina okutegeka mu tebuleni okusinziira ku muwendo gwa kaboni mu nziring’anya oluvannyuma bannyonnyole engeri eno gy’ekolamu okusinziira ku bunene bw’enkolagana molekyu ze ziraga.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Mu bibuuzo bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira okukozesebwa okukulaakulanya endowooza y'abayizi ku ngeri gye basoma mu kibinja nga basoma wamu mu kibiina?
answer_a: Oyinza otya okuzuula amakulu g'ebigambo ebitamanyidwa?
answer_b: Ekigendererwa ekikulku mu katundu ke tumaze okusoma kye ki?
answer_c: Omutwe ki gwe wandiwadde ekwandiiko kino gwe tusoma?
answer_d: Omutwe ki  ogw'ekyo kye tumaze okusoma ?

question: Mu kiseera ky'okusoma okunnyonyola ebiwandiiko, abayizi mu kibiina ekyookuna mu pulayimale balaga ebizibu okwawula wakati w'omulamwa be ekirowoozo ekikulu. Ku binnyonyoddwa wammanga entuufu enaleetawo enjawulo?
answer_a: Omutwe gw’ekigambo gwe gulinga ennyanjula y’ekyawandiiko era gukubibwawo nga tubuuza “Kiki kye twagala okwolesa mu kyawandiiko?” ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye biringana n’amalirizo g’omutwe.
answer_b: Omulamwa gwe tuteekateeka okumaliriza ku ki ekyogerwa mu mutwe, ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye bimu ku byo ebiyamba okutuuka ku malirizo ago.
answer_c: Omutwe gw'ekigambo kye kigenda okwogerwako era kizuulwa kubanga kiba mu mutwe gw'ekitabo, ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kibeera mu katundu akasooka.
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekigambo guddamu ekibuuzo “Ekiwandiiko kino kifa ku ki?” ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kigwa mu mugatte gw'ekyo ekigambiddwa ku mutwe ogwo.

question: Valentina ali mu kibiina kya PreK era akulakulanye mu bukugu bwe obw’okuwandiika, ng’asobola okugatta obutonnyeze okusiiga ennyiriri ez’enjawulo, n’okukuuma obutayosa mu makubo. Okusinziira ku mitendera gy’okutandika okuyiga okuwandiika, bukugu ki obuddako omuwala ono bw’asaanidde okutendeka, ng’assa ekitiibwa mu mutindo gw’obuzibu bwabyo?
answer_a: Koppa enjatuza nga bw'eziri.
answer_b: Lambulula ebibalo ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo.
answer_c: Kuba ebifaananyi bya arabesque eby'obwereere.
answer_d: Londoola amakubo nga ogoberera ettolobero n'ebiwujjo

question: Omusomesa agenda kutandika akabiina akusoma ku byakatemba. Nga tannatandika, agenda kukola akeesso akamuyamba okumanya obumanyirivu bw'abayizi, era ekigendererwa kyo'mwesso guno kwe : "Okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebigendererwa mu bintu byaakatemba." Kiki ekikulu ekyetaagisa okuba mu mwesso guno?
answer_a: Ebyafaayo by'emizannyo egy'ekinakatemba
answer_b: Enkola ey’omunda n'eyebweru eyebintu ebinyuvu era ebinyuma
answer_c: Enjawulo enkulu wakati w'emizannyo egyisesa n'ebyo ebyenaku
answer_d: Enkola z’okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko eby’obuwangwa

question: Soma embeera y'ekibiina wammanga: Mu zimu ku lesooni ze eziddirira, omusomesa wo olungereza Alina okumaliriza ebirina okuyigibwa: "Okukyusa ebigambo mu biwandiiko ebiwandiiko." Ku bigendererwa by'okuyiga ebiweereddwa kiriwa ekikwatagana n'ekiraga eky'okuyiga?
answer_a: Londa ebigambo ebimu ebiri mu muwandiiko
answer_b: Fumiitiriza okuva mu biwandiiko okumanya ebintu ebikulu oba ebitono ebikulu ebiwandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Laga ekirowoozo ekikulu mu mawulire agawandiike obuwandiike obugazi oba obutongole.
answer_d: Laga okutegeera amawulire agawandiike obuntuntunu oba agawandiike mu bujjuvu.

question:

   Omukyala Parada,nga musomesa w'olulimi olungereza abadde akolerawamu n'abayizi be ku ngeri yo kwennyonyolako mu bigambo ebikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo okumala sabiiti bbiri eziyise basobole okuba nga bennyolako nga boogers.Olwaleero omukyala awuliriza alipoota za bayizi be nga bennyonyolako engeri gye baddukanyamu emirimu gyabulijjo.Newankubadde Mukyala Parada yakizuula abayizi bangi bakoze ensobi mu nkozesa y'oluliminga boogera ,teyabateereza me bagenda mu maaso n'okwogera kwabwe.

question: Ssinga otunuulira embeera eri mu ssomero eno: Emu ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga olungereza mu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu kwe "kwogera omuntu ky’alowooza nga akozesa obwogezi obumala eddakiika nga ssatu n’emboozi ennyimpimpi nga mulimu okukyusa ebirowoozo emirundi nga kkumi na mukaaga nga mw’otadde n’emikolo gy’emyaka egiyise n’omukolo gw’okutegeeza ekyo abalala kye boogedde, ng’olaga ekigendererwa". Bwe baba bakebera obuwanguzi bw’ekigendererwa kino, abayizi mu mutendera guno basabwa kwanjula emboozi mu bubinja obw’abantu bana nga balina okukozesa ebigambo ebimu ebiweereddwa, n’enjogera era nga balina ekigendererwa ekimu. Buli bbinja lwe limaliriza okwanjula emboozi yaabwe, Mwami Fuentes, omusomesa waabwe ow’olungereza, ayimiriza emboozi okukola obulongoofu ku nsobi z’ebbalangulo oba enjatula abayizi ze bakoze. Okusinziira ku ndagiriro ezikwatagana n’okukebera eziragiddwa ku programu y’okusoma ey’omutendera guno, lwaki Mwami Fuentes aba takwatagana nazo?
answer_a: Olwokubanga enzirukanya z'ebigendererwa by'okuyiga ez'omulembe guno ziraga nti okwogera kulungi okukulaakulana mu mbeera ey'obuteefu.
answer_b: Olw’okuba okusalako omuyizi ebigambo ng’akyayogera okumukolako obubi ku ngeri gy’alimu okwogera.
answer_c: Okuva abayizi abava ebweru be bakola ensobi mu bigambo bye boogera era nga tebasobola kuziggwayo ddala.
answer_d: Olwokubanga okukola ensobi kitundu ku buli mukutu ogw'okuyiga era abayizi balina okuweebwa omukisa okwogera kyebalowooza nga tebatya.

question: Omusomesa mu somo erikwata ku nzirukanya y'ennimi awa abayizi be omutwe gw'amawulire guno: Ndi mukakafu nti Cristiano Ronaldo agenda kuwummulira mu Madrid. Kika ki kya kigambo ekiri wansi ekirina okukimanyibwa abayizi mu mutwe gw'amawulire oguli waggulu?

answer_b: Ekigambo ekiggumiza erinnya
answer_c: Ekigattiro ekiggumiza embeera
answer_d: Ekigambo ekiggattiddwa ku kigambululo ekiraga obudde, ekifo, oba engeri.

question: Mu kitundu ky’ebitontome, omusomesa asomesa abayizi be ekitontome kino: Mu nnaku ezo nnalina emyaka amakumi abiri era nga ndi mukambwe. Nnali nfiiriddwa ensi naye nga nfuna ekirooto. Era bwe nnalina ekirooto ebyo ebirala byali tebikyali bya mugaso. Ka kibe nga kikwata ku kukola, okusaba, oba okusoma ku makya nga ndi n’embwa ez’omukwano. Ekirooto kyali kibeera mu kifo eky’omwoyo gwange. Ekisenge eky’embaawo, mu kisiikirize, mu bitundu by’obutiti. Era ebiseera ebimu nnafuukafuukanga ne nkyalira ekiro[oto: ekifaananyi eky’olubeerera ekiteekeddwamu ebirowoozo ebirungi, ekisolo ekyeru ekikyukakyuka mu kwagala. Okwagala okutaliiko kkomo. Ekirooto mu kirooto. Era ekirooto ne kigamba nti: ojja kukula. Ojja kuleka emabega ebifaananyi eby’obulumi n’ekizibu era ojja kwerabira. Naye mu nnaku ezo okukula kyandibadde kikyamu. Ndi wano, ne ŋŋamba, n’embwa ez’omukwano era nja kusigala wano. Embwa ez’omukwano, Roberto Bolaño. Kiki ekireetera omuyimbi okuyimba abayizi kye balina okutegeera mu luyimba oluyimbiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Okwagala kw'omutontomi okw'obutamanya
answer_b: Omutontomi Obutamanya waava(mizizi)
answer_c: Ekirooto ky'obuvubuka bwo'mutontomi
answer_d: Emkiwano gy'omutontomi emivubuka

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okubiri asomera abayizi be ekiwandiiko ekiddirira okukola ku kutegeera ebiwandiiko ebiwandiike: "Kyali kifo kisirifu era nga kijjudde enzikiza. Akawoowo k'obunyogovu kaali kajjudde mu bisenge, era ng'ebigere by'omuntu bwe bitambula mu madaala amawanvu, eddoboozi lyabyo lyawulirikanga nnyo." Oluvannyuma lw'okusoma, abayizi abasinga obungi tebaasobola kunnyonnyola kifo ekyo mu bigambo byabwe. Lwaki ekiwandiiko ekyo tekisaanidde kukozesebwa mu kusomesa abayizi b'ekibiina eky'okubiri okutegeera ebiwandiiko?
answer_a: Kubanga kirimu ebigambo ebirina amakulu agategeerekeka
answer_b: Kubanga kirimu obunyiriri obulala.
answer_c: Olwekubanga mulimu ebigambo ebizibu.
answer_d: Kubanga bwe bunnyonnyofu bw’ekifo ekitalina mannya.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okuna asaba abayizi okuleeta ebyokulabirako by’enfuumo okuva awaka. Ekklaasi bw’etandika, annyonnyola nti enfumo bububonero obumpi obusobola okukozesa oluyimba era obukiikirira ekitundu ku magezi agaliwo oba amagezi agabantu bonna. Abayizi baleeta enfumo ze baleese, nga muno mulimu: "Embuzi eweereddwa tekebera mannyo", "Mu nnyumba y’omuweesi, akambe k’omuti", era "Akanyonyi akali mu mukono kasinga ebikumi ebiwanuka." Oluvannyuma, mu bibiri bibiri, abayizi bakola kaadi z’enfumo ze baleese okuva awaka, banyumya ku makulu ga buli emu, era oluvannyuma, buli kibiri kinnyonnyola enfumo zaabwe eri ekklaasi. Kintu ki ku kusoma omusomesa ky’asinga okukwatako mu mulimu guno?
answer_a: Okunnyonnyola engeri ennimi ez'ekifaananyi gye zikozesebwa
answer_b: Enkolagana wakati w'ekiwandiiko n'obulamu obwa bulijjo
answer_c: Okwekenneenya amakulu agvamu engero
answer_d: Okutegeera omugaso gwe nnono y'abantu

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa atandika okusomera abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekisooka olugero buli lunaku, era awandiika ku kibbali ky'ekibiina erinnya ly'olugero lwe bagenda okusoma: "Olugero lw'ekibira eky'ekisiru". Oluvannyuma, abasoomesa okuzuula olugero lwe bagenda okusoma. Josefina ayimusa omukono gwe n'agamba: "Nnyinza okukikola," era n'atandika okusoma mu ddoboozi eriwulikika, ng'addiŋŋana okusoma emirundi ebiri, okutuusa lwe yagamba: "Tugenda kusoma Olugero lw'ekibira eky'ekisiru."Josefina ali mu mutendera gwaki ogw'enkola y'okusoma?
answer_a: Ekyapaango ky'ennukuta
answer_b: Nga tannaba kuwandiika bigambo mu nkula yabyo
answer_c: Olunnukuta
answer_d: Ennyingo z'ebigambo

question: Omusomesa atunuulidde omuwala mu ssomero ly'abaana abato, bw'abadde awandiika erinnya lye, aliwandiise mu ngeri ekyamu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu kifaananyi kino: Nga tutunuulidde engeri omuwala gy'awandiiseemu, kiti kiki ekyetaaga okukolebwako naye okuyamba okuyiga kwe?
answer_a: Okutegeera okulaba.
answer_b: Okufuga okw'ebbali.
answer_c: Okusoma obuntambula.
answer_d: Okukwataga ya okw'amaaso n'emirimu gy'emikono.

question: Mu kibiina eky’omukaaga, omusomesa w’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya agenda kutandika omutwe guno: "Okuwandiika obutuufu, nga tukozesa amateeka g’akabonero akawunzifu." Kuyiga kyi abayizi kwe balina okumanya okusobola okutegeera akabonero akawunzifu?
answer_a: Omulamwa gw'ekiwummulo
answer_b: Omulamwa gw'akazannyo k'amaloboozi
answer_c: Okutegeera ebigambo eby'akawango kamu
answer_d: Okutegeera ebigambo ebifaanagana mu nnyingo

question: Mu kibiina ky'olulimi, okukozesa omulamwa gw'obubaka obw'ekikungo (propaganda), omusomesa asaba abayizi okukola kampeyini ekubiriza okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi munda mu ssomero. Ku lw'ekyo, emirimu egy'enjawulo gissibwawo, gamba ng'okutegeera embeera y'essomero ku by'okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi, okuteekateeka ebiruubirirwa bya kampeyini, okubaga omukutu ogw'obuwangwaazi, n'okunoonya ebikozesebwa eby'obukugu okutambuza omulimu guno. Okukekkereza okutuukirizibwa kw'ekitundu ekisooka ekya kampeyini, omusomesa awa buli kibinja olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola (checklist) basobole okwekebera bokka. Lwaki kisaanira okukozesa olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola mu kitundu kino ekisooka ekya kampeyini?
answer_a: Kubanga buli muyizi asobola okumanya engeri gy’akolamu mu mirimu gye gimuwebwa.
answer_b: Olw’okuba abayizi bajja kusobola okwawula ebikorwa bye bamaze okukola mu biti.
answer_c: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okwekenneenya mu bujjuvu buli kimu ku bikolwa bye bakoze.
answer_d: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okukakasa oba bamalirizza emirimu egibadde gibakwasiddwa egyekuusa ku kampeyini.

question: Abayizi abali mu kibiina ekyomusanvu bakola ku nkola entongole eye muko gw'empapula z'amawulire, era olw'ensonga eno, omusomesa abasabye okufulumya ebiwandiiko by'amawulire. Kiki ku bintu ebikozesebwa  wammanga ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukakasa obanga ebintu ebikola empapula z'amawulire birabika mu biwandiiko ebyafulumiziddwa?

answer_b: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa
answer_c: Ebikuumibwa bya anecdotali.
answer_d: Ekyokulabirako ekikulembera

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ekisoma okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko ebirimu okukaayana mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, ng’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga kiri ‘Kutegeera endowooza y’omuwandiisi, ensonga ze n’engeri gy’akozesaamu obukodyo bw’okuwandiika obulungi’, omusomesa ateekwa abayizi okusoma n’okugeraageranya ebbaluwa eri omukulu w’amawulire ezikwata ku nsonga y’emu. Ku biragiro by’okukebera ebiteereddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyateereddwawo mu kibiina?
answer_a: Londa omulamwa omukulu ogw'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'otunuulira enkozesa y'ebigambo n'engeri ebigambo bwe bitegekeddwa.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri emiramwa gy’emyawulo egyolekeddwamu mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo okusinziira ku ngeri ebirowoozo gye bitegekeddwamu n’engeri ebigambo gye bikozesebwamu.
answer_c: Kola endowooza yo ku nsonga eyanjuddwa mu biwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebikozesebwa eby'obumu n'obwegattiro.
answer_d: Wawula amakulu ag'omutwe, ng'osinziira ku by'obuwangwa ebikozeseddwa, okutegeera ekigendererwa ky'omuwandiiko.

question:
Omusomesa akola n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekyokusatu ku kutegeera ebyo basoma okusinziira ku lugero "Empungu Eyekka." Wammanga waliwo ekitundu ekiggyiddwa mu mwoleso guno:
Edda nnyo, kyategekebwa nti ebinyonyi byonna eby'oku lusozi oluli okumpi n'ennyanja birina okufumbiriganwa. Okutuukiriza ekyo, ebirango byateekebwawo buli we waali osobola okusobozesa ebinyonyi okukung'aana ku mukolo. Waali wasigaddeewo obutikitiki butono okutandika omukolo era ebinyonyi byonna byali birindirira nnyo akadde ako, naye empungu yali terina gw'efumbirwa. Nga anakuwadde, yagenda. Embaga zaakolebwa; ebinyonyi byajaganya, newankubadde tebyeerabira nnaku y'empungu.
Omu ku bayizi be abuuza omusomesa: "Okunakuwala" kitegeeza ki?
Kino ku bino wammanga kiki ekiyinza okuyamba omuyizi okutegeera amakulu g'ekigambo kino ng'ayita mu kumanya akatundu akasooka ak'ekigambo?
answer_a: Noonya ekigambo ekiri mu kika kye kimu eky'ekigambo mu biwandiiko n'okugatta ebigambo byombi no obukodyo mu biwandiiko ebiyamba okuzuula amakulu gaakyo.
answer_b: Noonya ebigambo ebirala mu kiwandiiko ebirimu ebigambo ebigattibwako,obisazeeko era obikwataganye okusalawo ebigambo byonna ky'ebifaanaganya.
answer_c: Noonya ebigambo ebiraga obubonero bwa 'condor' mu kiwandiiko, obisazeeko era n'okubikwataganya n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula ky'ekitegeeza.
answer_d: Noonya ekikolwa eky'eyongerayo  n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula ky'ekitegeeza era obikwataganye n'ebigambo bibiri n'ensonga eriranaganye n'ekiwandiiko.

answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Ku  bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’omuwala oba omulenzi ali ku mutendera gwa “syllabic-alphabetic” mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukoppa erinnya lyabwe
answer_b: Awandiika  ebigambo ebyefananyiriza.
answer_c: awandiika ennyukuta ezaawukanye ze bamanyi.
answer_d: Akoppolola ebigambo ebitono okusobola okubaako kyayogerezeganya.

question: Ekitongole ekikuumira ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa mu ssomero kirina ebintu eby’enjawulo eby’okusomesa ebigendereddwa okukulaakulanya olulimi. Omusomesa w’abaana abato alina okulonda ekintu ky’ayagala okukozesa okusomesa abayizi be ku kumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okukozesebwa butereevu okukulaakulanya okumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi?
answer_a: Empapula eziriko ebigambo ebitegeeza ebitali bimu
answer_b: Domino y'eddoboozi ly'ennukuta entandisi
answer_c: Kaadi z’okulambika ebifaananyi n’ebigambo
answer_d: Kaadi z’okuzimbisa sentensi nga tukozesa obubonero bw’ebifaananyi.

question:
Soma mu kakko akava mu kiwandiiko ekya weebwayo omwana ali mu siniya ey'okubiri:

Mu katabo, omuntu asobola okulaba ewatali ddembe mu bawandikibwako , naddala omuntu akatabo gwe'ketolelako, okukola kyebaagala oba okweyisa nga bwe baagala. Ng'ekyokulabirako, mu kifo ekimu omuntu eyawandika ku katabo agamba nti tewali n'omu asobola kuwasa gw'ayagala ebyaddala kubanga bwe bakwatibwa basobola okusibwa oba okuttibwa. Kino kilabika bubi nnyo kubanga omuntu tasobola kuba ne ddembe okubeera n'omuntu gw'ayagala era, oluusi, mu nnaku zino, kino kisobola okulabika, ng'ekyokulabirako, abantu bw'akakibwa oba okwekaka okubeera n'omuntu olw'obwangu obw'efanana oba ssente so si lwa kwagala.
Ku bino ebiteekateeke ebisobola okuva eri omusomesa ku kiwandiiko ky'omuyizi, kiki ku bino ekiyinza okuba eky'amugaso ku nkozesa y'ebikwata ku biwandiiko?
answer_a: Bw’otooteekemu biwandiiko eby’okukakasa, endowooza zo zijja kuggwaamu obutuufu.
answer_b: Yongera ku kamunnyeenye ako n’ensonga endala ey’ekizibu era ogiwagire n’ekigambo ekiggiddwa mu katabo.
answer_c: Singa mu kifo ky’okwogera ku katabo, onoonnyonnyola ekitundu ky’ekiwandiiko ky’oyagala okwogerako, kyandibadde kyeyolefu.
answer_d: Ddamu osome omulongoosa ogunnyonnyola ebyo ebinukuta ebyoleka bye bikola era otunule nnyo ku byokulabirako ebiragiddwa.

question: Omusomesa wa kkindagateni yeetaaga okukola okukebera okuzuula obukugu bw'abaana mu bigambo, naddala obusobozi bwabwe okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo n'okutegeera ekibinja kye bigwaamu. Mbeera ki ey'omusomo esaanira okukungaanya obukakafu obukwata ku bukugu buno?
answer_a: Yita abaana okuzannya emizannyo gy'okuteebereza. Ebintu ebikulu ebikwata ku bigambo eby'enjawulo bijja kwogerwako, nga tokozesezza buyambi bwa kubiraba. Kozesa olukalala lw'ebintu okuwandiika engeri abaana gye bakolamu.
answer_b: Laga abaana ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebisero ebikiikirira ebibinja eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu ku bintu ebyo, okwogera erinnya lyakyo, n’okukissa mu kibinja mwe kigwa.Pima enkola ng'okozesa ekipimo.
answer_c: Yiita abaana okwetegereza akataabaliro akalimu ebibinja eby’enjawulo, era obawa kaadi ze balina okukwataganya n’ekibinja ekikwatagana nazo. Kozesa ebiwandiiko by'okwekaliriza okuwandiika enkola.
answer_d: Laga abaana empapula erimu ebika by'ebifaananyi by’ebintu eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu bakinyonnyole nga tebogedde linnya lyakyo. Bannaabwe balina okwogera ekigambo ekyo n’okwogera ekika kyakyo. Kebera engeri gye bakozesezzaamu ebipimo.

question: Omusomesa w'abaana ab'omutendera ogw'omu makkati yetegeereza nti ekibinja kye ekya abaana aboobuwala na aboobulenzi banyumirwa ebibaawo mu kuyiiya n'okunooyereza nga bakozesa emikono gyabwe mirundi mingi bwe bikozesebwa sitoole okuva mu mabaluwa ,magazini,obubonero. N'olwekyo,kutandikwa y'olusoma olw'okubiri, era abasaba entobo y'olulimi lw'ebigambo,"Okufulumya ebintu ebifaananyi ebiraga ebifaananyi byabwe mu mbeera z'okuzannya."-Okutuukiriza okukolagana kwa by'okulaba ne by'okunyakanya okuyita mu nkozesa y'ebintu eby'enjawulo,eby'okuzannyisa n'ebikozesebwa."Bumalirivu ki obw'okuyiga obutuukiriza ekiruubirwa ekyogeddwa omusomesa?
answer_a: Mu kibinja ekinene, mukole omulimu gw'okusoma ebitontome; oluvannyuma, abaana bakoppe ebigambo ebimu nga bwe beetondeera obubaka bwabwe.
answer_b: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana basabiddwa okusalako ebigambo okuva mu magazini n'empapula z'amawulire, ate oluvannyuma okukoppa ebimu ku byo nga bakola ebiwandiiko ebipya.
answer_c: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana bakubirizibwa okuwandiika awamu ekifo ky’emmere, oluvannyuma bafumbe nga bakozesa ebijiko, enfuuwe, n’ebbakuli okukola omugatte.
answer_d: Mu kibinja ekinene, somesa olugero mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka ate oluvannyuma oyite abaana okusiiga ebifaananyi by'ekibaawo eky'omugongo oba ebifo eby'enjawulo okuva mu lugero nga banoonyereza amannya g'abazannyi.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okusatu agenda kukola omulimu gw’okuwandiika olugero n’abayizi be, ng’asinga kwesigama ku ngeri y’okukyusaamu okutambulira awamu n’embeera y’okwogera. Nga twejjukanya ku ky’omusingi guno eky’omulimu guno, mu bibuuzo bino omusomesa by’abuuza, kibuuzo ki ekisaanidde okusinga abayizi okutandika okuteekateeka engeri gye bagenda okuwandiikaamu ebyo bye baagala okuwandiika?
answer_a: Olugero lwaffe luliyogera ku ki?
answer_b: Tugenda kuwandiikira ani olugero lwaffe?
answer_c: Olugero lwaffe lugenda kusiimattuka wa?
answer_d: Lulimi ki lwe tugenda okukozesa mu lugero lwaffe?

question: Mu kibiina kya siniya esooka, mu kiseera ky'okusoma ku nfumo n'ebitontome ebikwata ku butonde, omusomesa alina ekiruubirirwa kino: "Okwekenneenya ekifo ky'abantu ab'enjawulo mu nfumo ezikwata ku butonde." Okusobola okutuuka ku kino, alonze enfumo ez'enjawulo ezikoleddwa obuwangwa obw'enjawulo.Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira abayizi okukola okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Kola kaadi eziraga abantu abali mu nfumo n'obuwangwa bwe bavaamu.
answer_b: Kola ebifaananyi ebiraga enjawulo wakati w'abantu abakulu, abato n'abatali ba mugaso mu nfumo ezirondebwa
answer_c: Kola emmeeza eziraga engeri ebintu ebimu ebiri mu nfumo ezo gye bikwataganamu n’ebintu ebya bulijjo ebibinnyonnyolwako.
answer_d: Wandiika obuwandiike obumpimpi mwe bannyonnyola empisa z'abantu abakulu abali mu nfumo gye beeyisaamu.

question: Omusomesa,  mu siniya ey'okubiri, agenda kukola okunoonyereza n’abayizi ku byafaayo by’ebitabo eby’Omulembe Ogwa Zaabu, ng’asingira ku mpisa n’embeera y’ebyafaayo ey’ekiseera ekyo. Oluvannyuma lw’okunoonyereza ku yintaneeti, abayizi bagenda kuteeka awamu olukalala lw’ebitabo olugazi, ate oluvannyuma balonde ebiwandiiko ebisinga okuba ebituufu okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza. Ki ku bino  wammanga omusomesa by’ateesseza,  ogusinga okuba omutuufu okulonda ebiwandiiko ebinoonyerezeddwako?
answer_a: Kola ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku by'osomye okusinziira ku nsibuko z'osomyeko oluvannyuma osalewo ensibuko ki gy'ogenda okukozesa.
answer_b: Sooka osome ebiwandiiko mu bujjuvu okusobola okutegeera ensonga enkulu, oluvannyuma wetegeleze obukulu bw'amawulire ago okusinziira ku bigendererwa by'okunoonyereza.
answer_c: Kozesa obukodyo okuzuula omutwe n'ensonga enkulu ey'ensibuko z'osomyeko oluvannyuma ogatte obubaka okusinziira ku mitwe emitono, okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky'okunoonyereza
answer_d: Kola ebiwandiiko ebikulu ebikwata ku nsibuko era oteekewo ebiwandiiko ebiraga obubaka obutwalibwa okuba nga bwe businga okuba obw’omugaso mu kunoonyereza.

question: Omusomesa wa siniya, mu mutendera ogwookuna mu kitundu kye nyinnyonyola y'omulembe guno,alaga okunnyonyola okw'enjawulo naddala ku biwandiiko eby'omulembe guno. Oluvannyuma lw'okunyonyola endowooza ya polyphony mu biwandiiko wamu n'eby'okulabirako ebimu, akizuula nti waliwo abayizi abatannaba kutegeera bulungi kibeeramu biki. Mu kubanguyiza okutegeera, asalawo okunyonyola endowooza okuyita mu kugeerageranya. Kugeerageranya ki omusomesa kwa nakozesa okulaga okubanguyiza okutegeera mu ndowooza ya polyphony mu biwandiiko?
answer_a: Ekibiina ky'abayimbi ekya ssomero kiyimba oluyimba lw'essomero ku mukolo gw'eggwanga.
answer_b: Omukwano ogumu gusisinkana oluvannyuma lw'oluwummula okugabana ebifaananyi byabwe n'ebyo bye bayitamu.
answer_c: Omuntu ali mu kisaawe era n'ayogera ku nneeyisa y'abaana abakilizaawo.
answer_d: Omufumbo gw’ebimuli bwe gugwa okuva ku bbalakoni ne gugwa ku mmotoka eyimiridde, abalabye boogera bye baalabye.

question: Mu kibiina  eky'omunaana, omusomesa asaba abayizi okusoma olugero olumpi oluyitibwa 'Olugero' olwa Wislawa Szymborska ate oluvannyuma bakole ebibuuzo ebiyamba okutegeera obulungi ebyo ebiri mu lugero. Abavubi  abamu baaggya eccupa okuva wansi mu nnyanja. Munda mu ccupa mwalimu olupapula, era ku lupapula kwaliko ebigambo bino: "Muyambe!, Ndi eno. Ennyanja ensumuludde ku kizinga okutali bantu. Ndi ku lubalama era ninda buyambi. Mwanguyeko! Ndi wano!" –Tekuli lunaku. era kilabaika okuba  nga wayiseewo ebbanga ddene. Eccupa yandiba nga emaze ebbanga ddene nga etengejja – omuvubi eyasooka bwe yagamba. –Era ekifo tekiragiddwa. Tekimanyiddwa wadde nnyanja ki – omuvubi owookubiri bwe yagamba. –Si kya lubeerera wadde kya wala. Ekizinga 'Wano' kiri buli wantu – omulenzi omuvubi owookusatu bwe yagambye. Embeera yafuuka mbi, obusirise ne bubaawo. Amazima agawamu galina ekizibu ekyo. Mu bibuuzo bino wamanga ebyakolebwa abayizi, kibuuzo ki ekikulembera okutegeera amakulu g'olugero olusomeddwa?
answer_a: Ekigambo 'ekizinga "Wano" kiri buli wantu' kitegeeza ki?
answer_b: Enkomerero y’olugero yandibadde etya singa obubaka bwali busengeke bulungi?
answer_c: Lwaki abavubi tebawulira bulungi n’okuddamu kw’omusajja owookusatu?

question: Mu kibiina eky'okutaano,omusomesa ajja okwekkeneenya kyenkana ki abayizi be kye basomye ku nsengeka y'ebikolwa eby'okuzannya katemba Era okutuukiriza kino, agenda kuwandiika  ebiraga eby'enjawulo ebyo kulungamya okunoonya obujulizi ku by'ayize ebifunibwa .Kwekkeneenya ki wammanga okulaga akwawunti ezookutegera olutalo muzannyo gwo okuzannya katemba.
answer_a: Wawulaana ebikolwa ebikolebwa abantu abakola omuzannyo.
answer_c: Laga ensonga eziviiriddeko omuzannyi omukulu n’omuzannyi omubi okukola bye bakola mu muzannyo.
answer_d: Laga engeri ebikolwa by'omuntu omukulu n'omulabe mu muzannyo gye bikwatagana n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Omusomesa mu mwaka gwe ogwookusatu mu ssomero lya siniya,akola wamu n'abayizi be kubiruubirirwa bino wammanga:"okutegeera sitayiro y'okunnyumya." Nga mu kino, annyonyola obubonero bwa buli sitayiro,era alaga eby'okulabirako ebimu era awabula abayizi okwetegereza sitayiro mu bitundu eby'enjawulo ebiggiddwamu. Ekimu ku bitundu  mu sitayiro etali nteerevu wammanga: "Charles yeewunya obweru obuli mu njala ze. Zaali ntaagavuwamu n'obugumu ku nkomerero yaazo nga zakula bulungi n'amasanga ga diyeppi eyakula nga amanda. Naye omukono tegwali mulungi mpozzi n'okusiibuuka,era nga gufanaana nga embalaasi mu nnyingo; era gwali muwanvu nnyo era nga gubulamu ebifuga ebigonvu eza miyala z'enkula. Ekyali ekirungi ge maaso; newankubadde gaali ga kitaka, galabika nga amaddugavu olw'obukoowekoowe nga era entunula yali  n'obwesimbu n'obuvumu bwe bbugumu."(Madam Bovary, Gustave Flaubert). Omu ku bayizi addamu nti ekitundu kirina sitayiro etali ntereevu kubanga waliwo omunyumya w'omuntu owookusatu. Nga otunuulira okuddamu okwo,kesiima ki okukwatagana ne sitayiro z'okunyumya eyetaagisa omusomesa okukozesa eri abayizi okutugeera sitayiro etali ntereevu?
answer_a: Okutegeera engeri omutontomi gy’atunuuliramu ebiri mu lugero
answer_b: Okutegeera ebika by’abanoonyereza mu mboozi
answer_c: Enjawulo wakati w'eddoboozi ly'omunnyonnyozi n'ery'abantu abakola ebikolwa mu lugero
answer_d: Okumanya omuntu annyonnyola byafaayo gy’ayimiridde okutunulira ebyo by’annyonnyola.

question: Bukenkufu ki ku bukuweredwa  ,obusobola okumanyisa  amakulu g'ebigambo  era lwaki?
answer_a: Okutondekawo sentensi n'olukalala lw'ebiseera kubanga bikiriza okutegeka ebigambo.
answer_b: Okukola okwawula n'okufaananya okw'omumwa kubanga bikusobozesa okuwa amakulu eri ebigambo
answer_c: Okwegezaamu mu ntambula oba envugga n’okwawula ebigambo mu nsalango kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeera eddoboozi ly’ebigambo.
answer_d: Okukozesa emizannyo gy'ebiseera by'ebikolwa n'okunnyonnyola empisa z'abantu kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeka ebigambo.

question: Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekireetera omuyizi okukulaakulanya okumanya enkozesa y'olulimi mu mbeera ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Zuula ensobi mu kyogera mu bigambo ebiri mu ngero ennyimpi.

answer_c: Gongyola ebiwandiiko  ebikuweeredwa mu bikikyo ebyenjawulo
answer_d: Tegeka sentensi ennyangu mu ngeri endala ku eyo eteereddwaawo.

question: Nga bakola na abayizi ku kigendererwa:'Ssaako langi nga okozesa enkola y'okusiiga ebifaananyi ebisikiriza.' Nsobi ki abayizi ze basinga okukola nga baddamu okutuukiriza langi ez'enjawulo mu bye batabudde?

answer_d: Gabula langi emu enkulu n'endala enkulu okukola eya sekenda

question: Omusomesa nga akolera wamu nabayizzi ku nsonga ya langi zobubonero.Mukibiina omuzzi yamubuuza "langi yo bubonero ekozesebwa etya mubulamu bwa bulijjo?"Biteeso ki wammanga ebirimu ebyokulabirako omusomesa byayinza okugamba omuyizzi?
answer_a: Mu langi  ekozesebwa mu myooga gye ngoye,Eriwa efaanana langi ye ttaka
answer_b: Bwensiiga nenzigyayo engeri gye mpulira nga mpitira mu langi
answer_c: Nga ntekawo ekyokulabirako ekye kitabo
answer_d: Mu langi egatta nga ekola ,okugeza akakoloboze ka baasi kalabika mangu

question: Omusomesa ayimiridde ku maaso g'ekibiina aweereza ebyuma ebikola ebiwandiiko, era omu ku bayizi be amubuuza: Kyuma ekikuba ebiwandiiko ekiyitibwa intaglio era ku lwaki? Ku nsonga eziweereddwa wammanga erimu eky'okuddamu omusomesa gya ayinza okuwa okunnyonyola ekibuuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Okuyoola ebifananyi, kubanga omuti ogukolebwako kiyoolwa n’ebyuma eby’enjawulo ebisala era ne bikola obutimba obw’omunda mu muti ogukolebwako.
answer_b: Okukuba ebifaananyi nga okuyita mu mutimbagiro, kubanga bwetaatira ayita mu busera bw’olutimbe okukola ekifaananyi ku bintu nga olupapula, engoye, oba ebintu ebirala.
answer_c: Okuyoola n'okukuba ebifaananyi nga bakozesa amazzi, olw'okuba bwino aba yeesigadde mu tunyiro otuba twakoze mu kikaati ky'ekyuma, n'olwekyo, ekifaananyi ekikubiddwa kiva mu tunyiro tw'ekikaati so si ku ngulu kwakyo.
answer_d: Obuwandiike bwa lithography, olw’obuzito bw’ejjinja erikozesebwa, nga bugattiddwa ku bunene bw’amaanyi agasaanikiddwa ekyuma ekikuba ebifaananyi, butondekawo akabonero omubala gwe gweyoleka nga gulinnye waggulu katono.

question: Ngeri ki esinga okusaana okukozesebwa okukola omulimu, okwanguya abayizi okutegeera enkola y'okusiiga ebifaananyi eya Jackson Pollock?
answer_a: Kozesa okutereeza ebifaananyi okukola omutindo gw'okutambula mu by'olaba
answer_b: Kozesa ebikolwa by'omubiri okuleka akabonero akali mu kifaananyi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebikwaso eby’enjawulo nga bw’okozesa engeri z’okusiiga ez’enjawulo.
answer_d: Kozesa ebifaananyi ebitaliimu mulamwa okukola ekunganiro lyebifananyi.

question:
Omusomesa ow'ekibiina ekya pulayimale eyo kutaano alaga abayizi be ebifaananyi bya Chile okuva mu biseera eby'enjawulo, ng'annyonnyola engeri ez'enjawulo abasiizi byaabyo gye bakozesaamu langi, enkula, n'okumulisa. Oluvannyuma, abasoomooza okulonda ekifaananyi, ekitali mu byo bye balabye, okwekkaanya kinnoomu ebintu bye bimu eby'olulimi olw'okulaba bye bayigiriziddwa. Ku nkomerero, abayizi baleeta okwekkaanya kwabwe mu kibiina. Omusomesa akola omulimu guno ng'akozesa akabonero.

Lwaki okukozesa enkola eno ewagilwa okukebera ekigendererwa ekiragiddwa mu mulimu oguyise?
answer_a: Kubanga kizingiramu okukola ebintu eby'enjawulo ebirina okwawulibwa okusobola okuwa omuyizi obubaka.
answer_b: Kubanga akabonero kakiliza okugatta ebipimo eby'enjawulo .
answer_c: Kubanga akabonero kakiliza okwetegeleza nga togabye makisi oba okuwa endonwooza yo ku muyizi kyakoze,naye ku ngeri gya kikozeemu.
answer_d: Kubanga akabonero kakiliza okulonda enkozesa esinze okuva mu bayiizi bye betegelezza.

question: Omusomesa bwaaba ayagala abayizi be okubeera abetegefu okulaga ekiseera kya Baroque okusinziira ku ndabika y'ebintu etali yabuligyo, njigiriza ya kikula ki gyebalina okusaako essira?
answer_a: Enjawulo wakati w'ebiyimbibwa ebyenjawulo  n'ezikubibwa.
answer_b: Okutegeera okubaawo kwebika byenyimba
answer_c: Okumanyisa abatutumufu abaakola ennyimba: Vivaldi, Bach, Haendel
answer_d: Okunnyonnyola ebintu eby'enjawulo ebyaliwo ebyatandika era ne bimaliriza mukiseera wakati wa 1600 ne 1750.

question:

Omusomesa w'okuyimba n'ebivuga ayise bayizi be okukola omulimu gw'okukuba ebivuga, mu kusooka, asooka n'abayigiriza oluyimba olw'ekika ekimu olutali lwangu, ate n'olw'ekika ekirala. question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kiseera omusomesa ng’annyonnyola ebika by’obubonero bw’ebiseera, akiraba nti abayizi be abasinga obungi tebasobola kuwulira njawulo wakati w’ebika by’obubonero bw’ebiseera ebirina omuwendo gw’obukuba bwe gumu naye nga byawukana mu mugawanyo (2/4 ne 6/8, 3/4 ne 9/8, 4/4 ne 12/8). Kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okukola okuyamba abayizi okwawula enjawulo ezo?
answer_a: Weetebwa omuyizzi gw'ennyimba ogulaga enjawulo zino.
answer_b: Kyusa akabonero k'obudde aka melody ennyangu nga okukozesa omu kubambi akakola ebipande by'ennyimba.

answer_d: Okunnyonnyola engeri empalo gy’eyawulwamu mu bibiri n’ensatu nga tukozesa okumanya kw’abuyigirizwa kwe balina ku by’emikutule.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku mulamwa gw’ebintu eby’obuwangwa ebiggumire ebigenda. Okwanguya okutegeera, abalaga ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo ebiraga omulamwa guno. Mu ngeri ki eno wammanga mulimu ekyokulabirako ekituufu eky’ebintu eby’obuwangwa ebiggumire ebigenda?

answer_b: Ebifaananyi by'amayumba agalangiriddwa ng'ebintu by'eggwanga eby'omuwendo omungi
answer_c: Ebisuwa ebyedda
answer_d: Abantu abajukirwa nengero ezinyumizibwa ezeeda

question:

answer_d: Okukozesa langi enzirugavu okukkiikirira ekisiikirize

question: Ku mulundi ogusooka, abayizi b’omwaka ogusooka mu Siniya basoomozebwa okukozesa okubajja embawo ng’engeri y’okweyoleka. Ku ndagaano zino wammanga, eruwa erimu olugero oluyamba okunnyonnyola okubaja embawo kwe kwesigamiziddwa?
answer_a: Ekiwandiiko ekikubiddwa okuva mu kyuma ekikuba empapula.
answer_b: Ekiwandiiko okuva ku sitampu ya ssabawandiisi ku ssomero
answer_c: Ekinkumu ku kaadi y’omuyizi eraga obuntu bwe
answer_d: Akabonero k'engatto z'abayizi ku ttaka ly'ekibiina.

question:
Soma embeera eno:
Omusomesa mu kibiina kya 5/6 akola enteekateeka erimu ebitundu bisatu ebigenda bigaziya, n’ekigendererwa ky’okukulaakulanya mu bayizi be okuwuliriza okwawula n’okuyiga okusoma n’okuwandiika ebikwata ku miziki.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'omunaana mu somero ateekateeka omutwe ogugenda okusomesa ogwa 'Enkola z'Okukulaakulanya Omuziki'. Kintu ki abayizi kye balina okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera ebiri mu mutwe guno ogugenda okusomesebwa?
answer_a: Enjawulo
answer_b: Omulembe gw'amaloboozi
answer_c: Omutwe gw'oluyimba
answer_d: Okukulakulanya oluyimba

question: Soma embeera eno  wammanga: Mu ssomero lya Middle, omusomesa ayagala kukola wamu na abayizi be ku dizayini ye ebibuga nga bakola ebifanaanyi eby'enjawulo ebyeyolekera mukifo ky'olukale mu kitundu kya amasomero.  Ngeri ki wammanga enaakolera abayizi ku dizaayini y'ebibuga ,okusinziira ku byogeddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Kuba ekifaananyi ky’endabika y’omulyango gw’essomero.

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ekyekumi nabiri, mu mutwe 'Okunoonyereza ku nnimi z'eby'obukugu ez'omulembe guno', omusomesa ayagala okunnyonnyola abayizi be, ng'ayita mu kikolwa, enkola y'okukola sitenso. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, engeri ki erimu ekikolwa ekisobola okunnyonnyola enkola eno?
answer_a: Kuba akakomo ku ssente zekinusu  oluvannyuma ozinyige .

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa wamu n'abayizi be abali mu mwaka ogusooka, ku nkomerero y'oluwenda 'Okusiiga ebifanaanyi ku bipande',bagala abayizi baabwe okwolesa okwekkeneenya ebirubirirwa wammanga: Okwekkeneenya ebifanaanyi byabwe okulowooza enkolagana wakati w'ekigendererwa eky'okwolesa,ebintu ebirabika obulungi n'ebifanaanyi.'Kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa okusobola okugera okutuukirizibwa kw'ekigendererwa ekyogeddwako waggulu?
answer_a: Basiima ebintu by’olulimi olw’obuwangwa ebikozesebwa mu pulojekiti zaabwe ez’ebifaananyi eby’oku bisenge.
answer_b: Banoonyeereza ebifaananyi byabwe eby'oku bisenge nga basinziira ku mutwe gw'ekigambo, ebintu ebikozeseddwa ebitaaggwaawo, langi, enkula, n'emirongo egiri mu kikungo.
answer_c: Bagezesa ebintu eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku mutwe gw'omulimu gwabwe.
answer_d: Bateekawo emikwano wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa ebitali bya bulabe mu pulojekiti n'enkula, ennyiriri, langi, n'emitendera egy'ateesebwa.

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina eky'okutaano, ng'akozesa omutendera Gw'okuwuliriza n'Okusiima, akola omusomo ogw'emirundi egiwerako, ogugenda okumalirizibwa n'omulimu ogugenda okubalirwa okusobola okukebera ekigendererwa "Okwolesa enneewulira, ebirowoozo, n'endowooza eziweebwa ennyimba". Mu biraga by'okukebera bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga ekigguddwawo?
answer_a: Baleeta eri abantu bonna emirimu gye bakola mu kiseera kyonna eky’okusoma.
answer_b: Banyumirwa nnyo okuwuliriza ennyimba ez'ebivuga n'ez'okuyimba.
answer_c: Balaga obuntubulamu mu nnyimba zaabwe nga buli omu ku lulwe nolw'abangi.
answer_d: Bayimba era ne bakuba enyimba eziva mu nsi ez'enjawulo, nga bateeka essira ku bulungi bw'amaloboozi mu nnyimba zaabwe.

question: Mukibiina ekyo munaana omusomesa ayanjulira abayizi be mungeri  gyebayinza okukola enkyukakyuka mu bubonero bwabwe.Bintu ki omuyizzi byalina okumaliriza okusobola okukwasaganya ebiteesedwa waggulu?

answer_d: Okunoonyereza ku nvuga yenkyukakyuka ye bikozesebwa

question: Mu kitundu "Okunnyonnyola ennyimba z'omu kibuga", omusomesa asaba omukubi wa ggita ento mu kibiina okukoppolola oluyimba oluwandiikiddwa okukubibwa n'eggita. Magezi ki abayizi gebalina okukozesa okusobola okugyayo omudido ogwetaagibwa ?
answer_a: Okusoma ennukuta z'ekivuvvuulo kya ggita

answer_c: Okusoma akalambuluzo k'Amerika
answer_d: Okusoma  entambula ya ggita

question: Mu kino ky'essomo “Okubumba n'engeri obutonde bw'abantu gyebalabibwaamu”, mu kibiina eky'omusanvu, omusomesa akola okukebera okuyamba okumanya obukugu bw'abayizi nga bakola pulojeketi y'okubumba ebifaananyi by'abantu. answer_b: Laga obuzibu obuzzeemu okulabika mu bifaananyi ebiraga endowooza y’omuntu era nonnyola emitendera egigoberelwa mu kulambika n’ebipimo ebigendererwa.

answer_c: Londa omulamwa oguliwo, era ogulage nga weyambisa ebikolwa.
answer_d: kozesa ebinti ebitali bwa buwangwa bye basudde oyangye omulamwa.

question: Mukibiina Kya siniya ekyo mwaka ogwokusatu, mu buli kitundu " ky'okutegeka  ebivuga," omusomesa ateekerateekera ebibiina nekiruubirirwa nti abayizi babangawo / bateekawo amateeka gabwe nga Bob mu kuyiiya. Eriwa ku zino engeri eyinza okuba eyomulaka oba eyenkizo kwebyo ebitegekeddwa okukolebwa enaabasobozesa okutuukiriza ekiruubiriwa kye omusomesa?
answer_a: Babangawo oba batandikawo entabula yebigambo,booleka eneeyisa yabyo, era nebategeka ebivuga mumaloboozi agategekeddwa oba agakwatagana obulungi, nga balondako ago aggiira ddala mu bigambo ebitegekeddwa.  Ekyamaxima bategeka oluyimba, nebatereeza ensobi, olwo nebalwanjula eri banaabwe abekinywi abo ababawa endowooza yabwe ku bivuddemu ebyenkomeredde.
answer_b: Bawaayo endowooza zaabwe nga abantu ssekinoomu eri banaabwe mu kibiina, balondako endowooza ekiikirira boiling  ekibiina ate nga eyoleka ekyo kyebeetaagira ddala mu kuyimba. Olwo nebetendeka era nabaluyimba oba nebaluweereza eri abantu nga ekibinja. Ekituufu bekeneenya ebyo ebiba bivuddemu nga bakola ennongoosereza kulwokuweereza oba okuyimba okwakamalirizo.
answer_c: Bateekawo okusoomozebwa era nebabangawo endowooza ezisooka okubasobozesa okufaayo ennyo mukuteekateeka ebyo ebinaabasobozesa okweyongerayo nomulimu ogwo. Kyamazima bakola ebintu bingi mukwegezaamu era nebekeneenya nenvuga mukusookera ddala awo nebaddamu okwekeneenya , nebatereeza ensobi awo nebagabana ebyo ebirowoozo ebibaddiddwamu banaabwe abekinywi wamu ne omusomesa.
answer_d: Bawuliriza ekitundu oba oluyimba olulondeddwa omusomesa, nebeekeneenya ebyo ebikozeseddwa mu kuluyiiya. Betendeka obutundu obwenjawulo  nebivuga ebyabwe awo nebaluyimba , oluvannyuma nebalukozesa okuyiiya ezaabwe mumbeera endala naye nga bassa ekitiibyo mwe byo ebyagobererwa okuyiiya olwasooka.

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina eky’abali mu mwaka ogw’okubiri mu ssomero lya siniya ateekateeka okukolera awamu n’abayizi ku kumanya enjawulo mu bitundu by’ennyimba ezimanyiddwa nga bayita mu kuwulira. Okukola kino, mu masomo agamu, abayizi bagenda kuwuliriza ennyimba ezirondeddwa era bawandiike mu bukwati bwabwe ebitundu bya buli lumu (olunyiriri, oluyimba oluddwamu, akawungeezi, n’ebirala), ebitundu bye bitegeeza bigenda kuyigirizibwa mu myito gyonna egenda okukolebwa. Bukugu ki obw’okuwulira abayizi bwe balina okuba nabwo okusobola okuyiga ebipya bino obulungi?
answer_a: Okusosola enjawulo z'ennyimba ennyangu.
answer_b: Okuzuula enkomekkerezo y'amayimba.
answer_c: Okuzuula okuddingana kw'amaloboozi n'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okutegeera enjawulo z'ekibiri

question:
Omusomesa Ali mukukola pulojekiti. Omusomesa ayagala okukozesa ebikozesebwa bibiri eby'okukebera. Ekikozesebwa ekisooka kyakukozesebwa mu nkola okurekodiya omutendera ogw'obukozi obw'omulimu obuggweereddwaawo mu buli kibiina, ate ng'ekikozesebwa eky'okubiri kyakukozesebwa ku nkomerero y'omulimu okwongera ku bukugu bw'abayizi okufumiitiriza ku nkulaakulana y'omulimu.

Mu ngeri ki ennungi esinga eyewooza, ebikozesebwa eby'okukebera ebisinga okutuukana n'ebigendererwa by'omusomesa?
answer_a: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa n'akabonero k'omuntu kinnoomu
answer_b: Empapula erimu ebyawandiikibwa eby'obukakafu n'ekipimo ky'omutindo ky'ekibiina
answer_c: Omubuulo ogw’okwekebejja n’okulambika ebikolwa by’abayizi
answer_d: Omutindo gw'okusiima n'ekyokulabirako ekikuyamba okwekebera.

question: Mu ssomero lya siniya ery’okusatu, omusomesa akola omutwe ogw’okuyiga ogukwata ku miziki egiriwo kati. Emu ku bigendererwa bye okuyigiriza kwe kuno: "Okutegeera mu bw’endowooza ne mu kuwulira engeri enzirukanya n’endabika y’oluyimba gye bitegekeddwa." Ku ngeri zino wammanga, eruwa eraga omutindo gw’omuyizi gwe bateekwa okutuukako ogukwatagana n’ekigendererwa ekyo?
answer_a: Kutondawo oluyimba olulina ekitundu ekisooka n’ekiddako
answer_b: Kitegeera ebitundu by'oluyimba olwa poopu
answer_c: Kyekenneenya engeri enkula ya bi-thematic rondo  ebirina emitwe ebiri gye bitegekeddwa.
answer_d: Ategeera engeri enkulu ez’ekitundu ky’omuziki ekikubiddwa nga tekiriko muyimbi.

question: Omusomesa w’abaana abato nga kole n’abaana abakulu  agenda kutekateeka ebintu eby’enjawulo mu kiseera ky’ekibiina ekinene okukubiriza ekigendererwa kino okuva mu kitundu ky’Ennimi z’Obuyiiya: “Okukoppa ebikolwa, entambula, n’amaloboozi okuva mu mbeera yaabwe ey’amakulu, okuyita mu ngeri ez’enjawulo.” Ku bino wammanga, kiki ekikolwa ekiyigiriza ekikkiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Wa abaana olugero olw'ekisimulo era obasabe okukola ekikwaso ky'omuntu gwe baasinze okwagala mu lugero olwo.
answer_b: Leetela abaana ebifaananyi by'ebisolo eby'enjawulo ebirina engeri gye bivuga era obabuulire okubategeera nga babiyita amannya.
answer_c: Muwandiise abaana okuzannya omuzannyo gwa "Simon agamba" era mulage, nga mukozesa bigambo bya mukono, ebintu eby'enjawulo bye balina okunoonya n'okuleeta.
answer_d: Yita abaana okuyimba n'okuzina ennyimba ezirimu okukola ebikolwa, gamba nga "To the Sound of the Crocodile" ne "The Monster of the Lagoon."

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n’ekibiina ky’omunaana ku mutwe gw’okuyiga ogwa Okuwuliriza, Okuyimba, n’Okuzanya emizanyo. Oluvannyuma, agenda kukebera ekigendererwa kino ekikulu: "Okunnyonnyola ebigambo ebikwatagana n'ennyimba eziri ku mutendera ogw'okuwuliriza; okusingira ddala ng'olowooza ku nkulaakulana y'obukugu bw'okuyimba obulungi n'okukyusa mu maloboozi". Kiki ekiraga nti omuyizi atuuse ku kuyiga kuno?
answer_a: Bayimba era bazannya nga bateeka essira ku ntandikwa n’enkomerero y’omulimu, nga bagunnyonnyola n’amagezi ag’okuyimba.
answer_b: Bayimba era ne bazannya nga bakozesa amaloboozi agasukka mu limu, nga bateeka essira ku nkulukuta z'ennyimba ezikwatagana n'omulimu n'endabika y'ennyimba.
answer_c: Bayimba era bazannya ennyimba eziri ku mutendera gw'okuwuliriza nga balowooza ku nkulaakulana y'obukugu bw'okuyimba obulungi n'okukyusa mu maloboozi
answer_d: Bayimba era bazannya nga bakozesa omukka n'ebipimo by'amaanyi mu mulimu ogunnyonnyolwa.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omusanvu, mu mutwe gw’ekitabo ogwa Okutondekawo Ebirabibwa, omuntu n’obutonde, akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku ngeri enkulu ez’ebikolwa by’obuyiiya obw’ettaka, ng’asinziira ku kwetegereza n’okwekenneenya ebikolwa by’abayiiya abakugu. Oluvannyuma, ateesa okussa mu nkola bye bayize mu pulojekiti y’okukyusa ekifo mu ppaaka eriraanye essomero n’okukwata ebifaananyi by’ebyo bye bakozesezza okuyiiya. Omusomesa agenda kukebera ebivaamu ng’akozesa ekipimo ky’okusiima. Okusobola okukung’aanya obukakafu ku ebyo abayizi bye batuuseeko mu kuyiga,  kyakulabilako ki omusomesa ky’ayinza okulowooza okuteeka kipimo ky'okwekenneenya?
answer_a: Bakola ebyafaayo by’ebifaananyi ebiraga omutindo gw’engeri omulimu gw’obuyiiya gye gukolebwamu ne by’enkomerero ebivaamu .
answer_b: Balonda ebintu eby'obutonde oba eby'obulamu obutereevu ku lw'omulimu gwabwe, okusinziira ku mirimu gy'obuyiiya ne gy'okusiiga ku ttaka.
answer_c: Balaga enkolagana eri wakati w'ekifo we bateeka omulimu gwabwe n'ekigendererwa ky'okwolesebwa kye baagala okutuusa.
answer_d: Balondamu ebintu ebirabika mu bifaananyi ebiraga ebikolebwa ku ttaka okusobola okukola ebifaananyi byabwe nga tebannakola mulimu.

question: Mu kibiina kya S.3, abayizi bakola ebintu eby'obuyiiya, ng'omusomesa w'essomo abasabye buli omu okukola oluyimba olutono olw'amaloboozi agatuukagana. Omu ku bayizi teyategeera mangu biragiro n'asaba omusomesa amunnyonnyole mu bigambo ebyangu oluyimba olw'amaloboozi agatuukagana kye lutegeeza. Ku ngeri zino wammanga, engeri ki omusomesa gy'ayinza okuddamu omuyizi mu ngeri entuufu era etegeerekeka?
answer_a: Kukola oluse lw'ebiwandiko ebiddamu eri ekiragiro eky'ekikulu oba ekya toniika.
answer_b: Kwekutolontoka n'okudda mu nnanga ku lw'oluyimba emirundi mingi okuva ku nnutti enkulu okudda gy'eri.
answer_c: Kwe kunnyonnyola omulimu mu nkola y'ebivuga ebiragiddwa okutambulira ku ndagiriro y'ennyingo ezikwatagana okwetoloola ennyingo enkulu, nga kikozesa nnyo endagiriro y'obuwulize bw'amaloboozi agatuukagana.
answer_d: Kukola omulimu gw'okuyiiya omuziki nga tuyita mu nkola ez'enjawulo ez'okutereeza n'ebikozesebwa.

question: Omuyigisa/ oba omusomesa w'e kibiina kyomwaka ogwokusatu ku ddaala lya haaya ateekerateekera abayizi enyimba, nekiluubirirwa kyabayizi abo okuzitaputa nobukodyo obuleetawo okumanyisa, engeri tekinologiya gyatwalibwamu oba gyakozesebwamu, nobukakafu  oba obukugu  munyimba ezo. Okutuukiriza kino, abalondera enyimba nga zirimu amaloboozi ga mirundi ena ngabalina okuzikolako mulusoma lwonna, ngabasoma, yetegereza nti newankubadde bayimbira ddala bulungi era nebaleetawo entegeero nga bakozesa obukoddyo mukutaputa, basigala tebaatula bulungi bigambo ebiri mukiwandiiko mungeri ennuπamu oba etegeerekeka nga bayimba, nolwekyo entegeero yengeri tekinologiya gyakozesebwamu oba gyatwalibwamu tefunibwa. Omusomesa ayinza kuddamu ki oba atya mungeri ennuπamu oba eyekikugu omuyizi ono okusobola okuyiga mulusoma luno?
answer_a: Entaputa nnungi ddala nga nsinzidde ku bukodyo mumulimu, wabula munyimba z'amaloboozi, kiba kikulu nnyo ekiwandiiko okukwataganira ddala nenvuga oba entambula yoluyimba, awo ebitundu bino byonna bisobole okwatulwa kyekimu oba okuwulilwa obumu.
answer_b: Nkuyozayoza  olwokutaputira ddala obulungi ekitundu kino, kati kikulu nnyo nga  mutaputa ennyimba zamaloboozi, abayimbi okuwuliziganya musobole okufuna enjatula entuufu ddala era eyamaanyi mwenna wamu.
answer_c: Weebale nnyo olwekyo kyokozeeko, naye okyalina okulongosaamu mu ntaputa y'omulimu , okukakasa enjatula yekiwandiiko entuufu, nkukubiriza oba nkusaba oddemu okwekeneenya ensoma yobubonero emirundi egiwerako.
answer_d: Obukugu wamu nentaputa y'omulimu egiddwayo oba efuniddwa bulungi. Wabula  okumaliriza omutendera, kikulu okusa essira oba amaanyi ku njatula yebigambo mu kiwandiiko nga oyimba. Kino kija kukusobozesa okutegeera obulungi amakulu gaakyo ,wamu nokufuula omulimu gwokuyimba omwangu ennyo oba okugwongeramu obwangu.

question: Mu kibangirizi abakubi b'ebifanaanyi ab'omulembe guno wamu n'okuddamu okutonda emirimu gyebwe; Mu kibiina ekya siniya eyookuna, omussomesa akola wamu na abayizi be omulimu ogusooka era nga mulimu pulojejikiti y'okunoonyereza nga ekiinja n'ekirubirirwa "Okunoonyereza engeri entongole wamu ebiseera n'obutonde okukola ebikolwa ebyob9ukugu okuva mu kitongole kya abakola ebifanaanyi eby'omulembe. Ku nkomerero y'okunoonyereza omusomesa alabiriza enjiga mu pulojekiti. Ku biragiddwa wammanga eriwa okukakasa obutuukirivu bw'ekigendererwa ekyatuukirizibwa?
answer_a: Banoonyezza mu буnyikivu ekigendererwa eky’okwolesa ebiri mu by’obugubi eby’omulembe ebikikirira ebibinja ebyalondeddwa
answer_b: Bakola omulimu gw'obuyiiya ogw'ekikolwa ky'obuyiiya ekya kati, nga balowooza ku mitindo egikola ekibiina ekyasomeddwa.
answer_c: Banannyonnyola engeri y’ebikolwa by’obugubi eby’omulembe ogwa leero eby’ekibiina ekyalondeddwa, nga babigatta n’embeera z’ebyenfuna n’ebyemabega by’ekitundu.
answer_d: Banoonnyereza ku lwaki balondeddwa ebikolwa by'obugubi eby'omulembe okuva mu kibinja ekyalondeddwa, nga balowooza ku bintu gamba ng'ebyo bye baagala n'enkolagana yaabyo n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Kiki ekibiina ky'ebipimo ekisobozesa okumanya obutuufu bw'ebyo omuyizi by'atuuseeko mu kusoma kwe?
answer_a: Bakozesa obutuufu ennukuta z'oluyimba olukoleddwako.
answer_b: Bakozesa obumanyifu bw’amaanyi n’obunafu nga bwekyetaagisa nga bakuba oluyimba. ■ Bakuumira ddala entindo y’ebiseera nga bakuba oluyimba, nga bagoberera obulungi obubonero obulaga engeri y’okukubaamu oluyimba.
answer_c: Ban ব্যাখ্যা accurately olutindo n'ennyimba ezikwatagana n'omuziki ogwo. ■ Bakozesa bulungi ebintu eby'enjawulo ebikwata ku bwangu n'amaanyi mu kuyimba.
answer_d: Bakola bulungi olutalo n'ennyimba ebifanana n'omuyimba ogwo. ■ Bongeramu ebintu mu kunnyonnyola gamba ng'okuyimirira, okutegeka, n'okwogera, n'ebirala.

question:
Ku ntandikwa y'essomo ly'okusiiga ebifaananyi mu byafaayo by'ebifaananyi, erikwata ku makulu g'ebifaananyi mu mbeera z'obuwangwa, omusomesa ajja kusooka kwekaliriza okumanya oba nga abayizi be ab'ekibiina eky'omukaaga basobola okutegeera ekigendererwa ky'ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo. Bw'amala okwekaliriza eby'okuddamu, akiraba nti abayizi abasinga obungi boogera ku bintu ebiri mu bifaananyi, gamba ng'obuwanvu bw'olunyiriri, enkula, n'erangi, awatali kwogera ku makulu agali mu bifaananyi ebyo. Kino kimulaga nti alina okukolagana nabo okusobola okubayamba okutegeera obulungi ebifaananyi ebyo.
Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisobola okuyamba abayizi okutegeera engeri y’okwekenneenya ekigendererwa eky’okulaga eky’ekikolwa?
answer_a: Omusomesa  asaba abayizi okwetegereza ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo eby'omulembe guno era balabe ebifaanagana mu bifaananyi ebyo.
answer_b: Omusomesa alaga abayizi ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo eby'omulembe guno era n'abasaba okumanya ebifaanagana mu bifaananyi ebyo.
answer_c: Omusomesa alaga abayizi ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo era n'abasaba okuwandiika engeri langi oba ebifaananyi ebyo gye bikwata ku muntu.
answer_d: Omukulu w'essomero alaga abayizi ebyokulabirako ebirungi eby'ebifaananyi era n'abasaba okulaga endaba y'ensi abasiizi b'ebifaananyi gye baalina nga basinziira ku kwekenneenya ebintu bye baalaba mu bifaananyi.

question: Omusomesa akola omutwe gw'ekitabo Abantu n'Ettaka mu kibiina kya munaana, ng'alowooza ku kiruubirirwa: "Kola maapu y'obulamu bwabwe nga basinziira ku ndowooza, enneewulira, n'ebirowoozo okuva mu bulamu bwabwe." Okukola maapu eno, omusomesa ateesa okukozesa omutendera gw'okukoola ebintu. Nkola ki ey'emirimu esinga okusaana okukulembera abayizi mu kukola maapu yaabwe ey'obulamu?
answer_a: Kola ekipande ekiraga obulamu bwo, wekenneenye ebitundu byakyo eby'enjawulo, kuba maapu yaakyo, era oteekemu ebitundu by'ekipande.
answer_b: Gattako ebifaananyi mu maapu, gamba nga okusiiga n'okukuba ebifaananyi, nonnyereza ku bifo ebiragiddwa mu maapu eyo.
answer_c: Kola ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku bulamu bwo, wekenneenye ebitundu byakyo eby'enjawulo, kuba maapu yaakyo, era oteekemu ebitundu by'ebifananyi n'ebisiige.
answer_d: Lowooza ku byafaayo byabwe, kuŋŋaanya era okole ebipande by'ebiwandiiko ku lupapula olunene, ssaawa ekiwooto, era okwataganyaamu okusiiga.

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina kya S.3, mu mutwe gw'ekigambo Eby'ennyimba Bye Bitulaga, atandika okukwata ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okukola omulimu omutono ogw'ennyimba nga bakolagana nga basinziira ku mbeera y'amaloboozi egimu, nga bakozesa eddoboozi lyabwe, emibiri gyabwe, ebivuga by'ennyimba, n'ebintu ebiwanika amaloboozi eby'enjawulo, okusobola okunoonyereza ku maloboozi agali okumpi agazingizza abayizi." Nkola ki esaanira abayizi okutandika okukolera ku kiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Okunoonyreza ku maloboozi g'ebintu eby'enjawulo ebinaayanguya enkola y'okutonda ennyimba.
answer_b: Okukola okunoonyereza ku butonde obulungi mu kyalo n'ekibuga.
answer_c: Okuzuula n'okuwuliriza amaloboozi mangi aganakola ku mbeera y'amaloboozi.
answer_d: Okulonda ebivuga nti buli memba mu kibinja bikyukakyuka mu n'okubyolesa mu lujjudde
