question: Okukola ku yuniti y'Okumanya Abasiizi b'Ebifaananyi Ab'omulembe n'Okuddamu Okukola Ebikolwa Byabwe, omusomesa wa siniya ategese okukola essomo n'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okuna mw'anaatambulira ku mirimu gya Frida Kahlo, ng'anyikiza obukulu obukulu bw'ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwe mu bisiige bye. Ng'omulimu, anaasaba abayizi okuddamu okutondeka ekifaananyi ky'omulunzi okusinziira ku birowoozo byabwe n'engeri zaabwe. Mu nkola y'okutonda ebifaananyi ebitonotono, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi bakoppa ebikolwa mu kifo ky'okubiddamu. Bibuuzo ki ebisaana omusomesa okubuuza abayizi okubalagirira n'okwanguya okwolesa ebirowoozo byabwe mu bikolwa byabwe?
answer_a: Ebintu ki ebyaliwo mu bulamu bwa Frida Kahlo bye yayolesa mu milimu gye? Birowoozo ki by'olabye nti yali ayolesa? Bifaananyi ki na langi ki ze wandikozesezza okukiikirira ebirowoozo ebyo?
answer_b: Olowooza emulimu gya Frida Kahlo gyandibadde gitya singa yali n’obulamu obutalimu kubonaabona kungi? Mu ngeri ki gye wandilazeemu okubonaabona? Biki ebifaananyi n’langi  ze wandikozesezza?
answer_c: Biki ebikubaddeko mu bulamu bwo ebikufaananya ku ebyo ebyatuuka ku Frida Kahlo? Birowoozo ki ebijjukizo ebyo bye bikuleetera? Bifaananyi ki na langi ki z’olowooza nti byandiyolesezza ebirowoozo ebyo?
answer_d: Ojukira engeri ebintu Frida Kahlo bye yakozesanga mu kukuba ebifaananyi bye byaali zitya? Engeri gy’akozesaamu ebintu ebirabika ng’ennimi eyongera etya ku ngeri gy’alagaamu enneewulira ze? Bintu ki ku by’akola byandikusiimye okukozesa mu bifaananyi byo?

question: Omusomesa asaba abayizi be okulaga emiwendo  ne'bisale byensimbi ne sente zentege, bamale bawandiike ebintu ebyo mu butabo bwabwe obutono . Biwandiiko byakikula ki omusomesa byajuliza mu kikolwa kino ?
answer_a: Okuggatta
answer_b: okupanga ebifo
answer_c: Okugeraageranya ebibalo
answer_d: okumenyamenya ebibalo

question: Lwaki okukozesa ebikokko by'emisingi emingi kusobozesa abayizi okukozesa obulungi okugatta obulungi  ?

answer_b: Emilia aweereddwa ekibinja ky'obukubusi buna, abwetegereza n'agamba omuwendo gwabwo. Oluvannyuma, obukubusi obulala busatu bwongerwako ku kibinja ekyo n'abuzibwa: obukubusi bwonna bwe nnina bwemeka? Emilia agamba nti waliwo obukubusi musanvu.
answer_c: Javiera aweereddwa akabinja k'obukomera butaano, abutunuulidde nagamba nti buliwo butaano. Oluvannyuma, alagiddwa akabinja k'emitayimbwa mukaaga era abuziddwa: mu kabinja kano mubaamu ebintu bimeka?, era ng'abala kinnoomu agamba nti mukaaga.
answer_d: Juan alagiddwa ebibatu mukaaga, n'abibala kinnoomu n'agamba nti biri mukaaga. Oluvannyuma, ebibatu bitwaliddwa ne byawulwamu ebibinja bibiri ebyenkanankana era n'abuzibwa: nina ebibatu bimeka muwera? Amangu ago Juan agamba nti biri mukaaga.

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina ekya siniya eyokubiri  Ali mu nteekateeka z'ekibiina ,ezilina ekigendererwa "Okugonjoola ebizibu nga tukozesa obutenkanankana obutereevu obulina ekintu kimu ekitamanyiddwa". question: Omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'okubiri ategese ekigendererwa ky'ekibiina wammanga:"Okuteebereza ekibaawo ku kigero Kya amazzi agakyusibwa mu konteyina endala." Ku mirimu egiweereddwa wammanga guliwa ogwandikoledde abayizi okwolesa okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekiragiddwa?

question: Bwembeera nina enkoko mukaaga era nga buli emu nga erina amagulu abiri,mu mugatte awamu gali amagulu ameka?

question: Omusomesa wa abaana abato ali kukola ku nnamba okuva ku emu okutuuka kukkumi, nga asaba abaana okumalayo ensengeka y'omuwendo nga bayita mu luyimba "Enjovu emu okubalansinga". answer_b: Geereza omuzeeyi bw’ali ewala, era gerera olubalalo lw’entambula lw’alina okukola okumutuukako.
answer_c: Tambula mu nnyiriri z'enzige, ng'obala amadaala ge bakuba okusinziira ku namba omusomesa gy'alaga.
answer_d: Kola ennyiriri z'enjovu, nga zeekakasa okuva ku nene okudda ku ntono oba okuva ku ntono okudda ku nene, okusinziira ku ekyo omusomesa ky'alaga.

question: Omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'omunana akola wamu n'abayizi be kukubisa n'okubagiza,ennamba ez'omugatte. Mu kiseera ky'ekibiina, omuyizi alaga nti"Ddala kisoboka okuddamu okuddamu okubaawo nga nkubisizaamu ensonga bbiri ennungi? Nyinyonyola ki ey'omusomesa wammanga esobola okuddamu omuyizi ate era wamu n'okwanguyiza okutegeera ekyogeddwako mu kibiina
answer_a: Ekibinja ky'ennamba eziteekeddwa mu mutindo gwa kyesiguzo kyeyongerwako ku kibinja ky'ennamba eza bulijjo; n'olwekyo, ekyava mu mpalizo z'ennamba eziteekeddwa mu mutindo gwa kyesiguzo ezirungi kikuuma obulungi bwazo. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako nga tukuba \(\frac{7}{3} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_b: Okusinziira ku makulu, ekyava mu kubisa namba ennungi bulijjo kiba kirungi; n’olwekyo, ekyava mu kubisa namba ezisondeka ennungi nazo zikola ku kiragiro kino. Ka tukole ekimu ku kyokulabirako eky’okubisa \(\frac{7}{2} \cdot \frac{5}{3}\)
answer_c: Ekinunulo ky'ebigera ebirambulukufu ebirungi kiba kinene okusinga ebintu ebigendereddwaamu singa byombi biba binene okusinga 1; n'olwekyo, kimale okuba nti ekintu ekimu kiba kitono okusinga 1 ekintu kino kireme okukola. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako eky'ekigendereddwaamu kya \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_d: Okukiikirira ekifaananyi eky'ekibala ky'emiwendo ebiri egiri waggulu wa ziro kigwa mu kwegatta kw'ebifaananyi bya buli kimu ku miwendo egyo; n'olwekyo, ekyo ekivaamu kiba kisaanye okuba ekitono okusinga egyo. Ka tukole eky'okulabirako nga tukozesa \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{2}{5}\)

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omusanvu alina ky’ayigiriza ku y'omuwendo gw’ennamba nga tezirina nyongelezza. Bw’abadde ng’akola olusoma olumu olwabadde ku lubaawo, omuyizi omu amubuuza: “Lwaki ebyavaamu biba mu negatiivu ng'ate waliwo akabonero ka negatiivu mu maaso g'omuwendo gw'ekintu? Wagamba nti omuwendo gw'ekintu gwonna guba mu pozitiivu, kale simanyi lwaki ekyo kiba bwe kityo.” Mu nnyonyola zino wammanga, nyonyola ki eddamu ekibuuzo kino mubutuufu, ng’ekozesa olulimi omuyizi w’ekibiina eky’omusanvu lw’asobola okutegeera?
answer_a: Akabonero aka negatiivu  akali mu maaso g'ekiwandike kitegeeza "omuwendo ogwongerwako ogwa inverse." Okuva absolute value bulijjo kubeera nene oba okwenkana ne zeero, omuwendo gwayo ogwongerwako ogwa inverse bulijjo guba muto oba okulingana ne zeero.
answer_b: Akabonero aka negatiivu nga kali mu maaso g’ekigambo kitegeeza nti “kyusa akabonero.” Okuva omutindo ogwa absolute value gubeera gusingako  oba gwenkana ne zeero, okukyusa akabonero kivaamu omuwendo ogutasingako i oba ogwenkana ne ziro.
answer_c: Akabonero ka negatiivu mu maaso g'ekigambo kyenkanankana n'okukozesa etteeka ly'obubonero mu kubisaamu ennamba nzijuvu. Okuva omutindo ogwa kyenkanyi bulijjo guba mukulu okusinga oba gwenkana ne ziro, nga bwekituukana nti "ennamba ennungi bw'ekubisibwa mu mbi kivaamu mbi," ekivaamu bulijjo kiba kito okusinga oba kyenkana ne ziro.
answer_d: Akabonero aka negatiivu mu maaso g'ekigambo kyenkanankana n'okuba n'ennamba eri negatiivu mu maaso. Okuva omutindo ogwa ddala bulijjo guba mukulu okusinga oba gwenkanankana ne ziro ate akabonero akabi kakyusa akabonero munda mu buteebentezi, omuwendo gwakyo bulijjo guba muto okusinga oba gwenkanankana ne ziro.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku mutwe gw’ekibalangulo gwa Aligebra, era mu masomo ge agagenda okuddako, agenda kwogera ku kigendererwa “Okukiikirira obutenkanankana mu ngeri entuufu, mu bifaananyi, oba mu bubonero.” Okutuuka ku kino, omulimu ogusooka gwakussa essira ku kuleetawo okumanya okwetaagisa okuyamba okutuuka ku kigendererwa kino. Kumanya ki omusomesa kw’alina okusooka okuleetawo mu mulimu ogusooka?
answer_a: 1) Okukyusa okuva mu lulimi obulijjo okudda mu lulimi lw'ekibalangulo. 2) Okukendeeza ku bigambo ebifaanagana
answer_b: 1) Okukolagana okwa namba enzijuvu. 2) Okugonjoola enkyenkanyaanamba ezitali za mugalamivu nga tuyita mu ngeri ez'enjawulo ez'okuzikiikirizaamu.
answer_c: 1) Okutegeera amakulu g'obubonero >, <, ≥, ne ≤. 2) Okunnyonnyola obutenkanankana nga tukozesa olupimo olutali lulungamu.
answer_d: 1) Okulaga obutenkanonkano nga tukozesa ebifaananyi. 2) Okunnyonnyola ebyavaamu okugonjoola obutenkanonkano.

question: Omusomesa ow'ekibiina eky'omukaaga akolera wamu n'abayizi be okugonjoola ebikwatagana eby'olubereberye n'ekintu kimu ekitamanyiddwa, ng'akozesa enkola ez'enjawulo. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga nti abayizi bayize okukozesa enkola eno mu kugonjoola ebikwatagana?
answer_a:
1) Kozesa ebintu ebirabika okulaga nti 14 = 6 + x; gamba ng'okukozesa minzaani etali mu mbeera ya kwenkanankana, ng'olina obutundutundu bwa 14 ku ludda olumu ate obwa 6 ku lulala.
2) Manya omuwendo gw'obutundutundu(obubokisi) obwenkanankana ne minzaani eyasoose.
3) Wandiika eky'okuddamu mu lulimi lwa algebra: x = 8
answer_b:
1) Tereeza ekikunizo 14 = 6 + x mu lulimi olw'obutonde ng'okozesa ebigambo nga "Nnamba ki eyongerwako ku 6 okufuna 14?".
2) Zuula nnamba ng'okozesa enkola 6 + 8 = 6 + x.
3) Wandiika eky'okuddamu mu lulimi lwa algebra: x = 8
answer_c:
1) Laga ekizibu "Namba ki bw'ogattako ku 6 ofuna 14?" ng'okozesa ekibalangulo 14 = 6 + x?
2) Ggonjoola ekibalangulo ekyateereddwawo, ofune x = 8.
3) Ddamu ekizibu ekyo.
answer_d:
1) Kozesa ekikunizo "Singa nnaweebwa obukalamu 6 era kati nnina 14, nnalina obukalamu bungahi mu kusooka?" ng'okozesa ekikunizo 14 = 6 + x.
2) Gonjoola ekikunizo ekiteereddwawo, ofune x = 8.
3) Ddamu ekikunizo

question: Omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina eky'omukaaga ku kiruubirirwa kino: okumanya ebifaayo by'ebitundu by'eggwanga eby'ebyobufuzi n'obukulembeze. N'olwekyo, asalawo okugatta omutwe guno ku mawulire gano agakwata ku kutondebwawo kw'essaza lya Ñuble n'okukola okunoonyereza ku nsibuko y'amawulire: Olukiiko lw'abakulembeze lukkirizza okutondebwawo kw'Essaza lya XVI erya Ñuble. Enteekateeka eno, kati etegekeddwa okulangirirwa, era etondawo amasaza amapya asatu. Chile egenda kuba n'essaza lyayo erye kkumi na mukaaga. Kino kyasaliddwawo Olukiiko lw'abakulembeze ku Lwakusatu luno oluvannyuma lw'okukkiriza n'obululu 26 obuwagira, bubiri obuwakanya, n'obutaalina n'omu ataalonze mu nkola yaabwe ey'okusatu omuteeko ogutondawo Essaza lya Ñuble eripya. Enteekateeka eno, kati etegekeddwa okulangirirwa, era egenda kutondawo amasaza amapya asatu: Diguillín (Chillán, Chillán Viejo, Quillón, Bulnes, San Ignacio, El Carmen, Pinto, Pemuco, ne Yungay), Punilla (San Carlos, Ñiquén, Coihueco, San Fabián, ne San Nicolás), ne Itata (Quirihue, Cobquecura, Ninhue, Treguaco, Coelemu, Portezuelo, ne Ránquil). Kika kya mawulire ki omuyizi ky'ayinza okuggya mu mawulire ago agakwata ku nteekateeka y'ebyobufuzi n'obukulembeze bwa Chile?
answer_a: Ebisaanyizo eby'obukugu eby'okukozesa okutondawo ekitundu
answer_b: Enkola y'ebifo eby'enjawulo mu kitundu ng'ekifo ekifugibwa.
answer_c: Ensonga ezisobozesa okukyusa ekitundu okukifuula eky’obuwangaazi
answer_d: Obukulembeze bw'ekitundu nga bwe butondekeddwaawo mu by'obufuzi.

question: Omusomesa ategeka okunoonyereza okwekeneenya okutondeka na abaana ba siniya esooka okupima okutuukiriza ekiruubirwa wulira engeri obukulembeze ku by'obuwangwa mu mbeera ey'abulijjo.ku mirimu egiweereddwa wammanga guliwa abayizi gwe balina okwolesa?

answer_b: Okukungaanya ebirowoozo okuteeka enkola y'okutabaganya ensi yonna mu mbeera y'ebiseera.
answer_c: Omuzannyo ogw'okuzannya ogukwata ku bukulu bw'okuyiiya ebipya mu tekinologiya mu by'empuliziganya
answer_d: Omwoleso ku nkola y’okutwalira amateeka g’amawanga amalala mu maka gaabwe emyaka egiyise.

question: Mu kibiina kya Siniya ekya waggulu ekisoma Ebyafaayo by'Amagezi, omusomesa n'abayizi be bakolera ku nzikiriza z'eby'amagezi eza R. Descartes. Mu bigambo bino ebiri wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n'obuzibu abayizi bwe bayinza okusisinkana, obukwata ku kutegeera omulamwa "Ndirowooza, kale ndi"?
answer_a: Fumiikiriza okubaawo kw'endowooza ya Cartesian cogito
answer_b: Okubeerawo okukwataganye n'okukozesa okubuusabuusa okw'entegeera.
answer_c: Kakasa nti okubaawo bukwatagana n’omulimu gwa cogito
answer_d: Laga engeri okubaawo bwa "res cogitans" gye kukwaatagana n'okubaawo bwa "res extensa"

question: Omusomesa wa siniya ategeka essomo erikwata ku nkola ya kantian okusobola okufuna okumanya; era okukikola kino, balina okumalirira ebibaddewo mu kuyiga nga tebinabaawo ebebaddewo eby'etaagisa abayizi baabwe okumala okwogera ku nkola eyo.Kiki omussomesa kyalina okulaba nti abayizi bakimanyi okusobola okutandika okuyiga enkola eyo?

answer_b: Tegeera endowooza y'Abangereza ey'obukakafu n'eyokugezesa ng'emigendo egyakulembera ekirowoozo kya Kant
answer_c: Londa endowooza z'ebiseera n'obwengula ng'enkola y'ebirowoozo ekyetaagisa okumanya, okusinziira ku I. Kant
answer_d: Tegeera endowooza z’ekintu ekirabika (phenomenon) n’ekintu ekitera kulabika (noumenon) ng’obunnyonnyofu bwa Kant ku ekyo ekisobola okumanyika.

question: Omusomesa ayagala  okugezesa  ng'ayita mu mulimu okulaba oba  abayizi be baategeera ebyavaamu mu kuggwa kwolutalo lwakasirise  . Ku mirimu egisabiddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikebera ekigendererwa kino?

answer_a: Tambula mu katale akali okumpi era osabe abaana bagule ebibala n'enva bwe muba mutambula.
answer_b: Tegekka enteekateeka ey'omuzadde okukyala, ajje annyonnyole engeri ekitundu mwe tuli gye kyatandika n'engeri gye kikyuseemu okumala ebbanga.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu "Obwetwaze bwa Chile", akola enteekateeka eno: Ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga: Okunnyonnyola engeri obwetwaze bwa Chile gye bwakulakulanaamu, ng'otunuulira abantu n'ebibiina ebyayambana, abasajja n'abakazi ab'amaanyi, okugenda mu maaso n'okuddirira kw'ensonga z'eggwanga, n'ebimu ku bintu eby'amaanyi ebyaliwo. Ku bikolwa ebiyinza okubaawo wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n'ebigendererwa by'ekibiina era ekisobola okuteekebwa mu nteekateeka?
answer_a: Maliriza omutemwa ogw'ebifaananyi ng'olaga emitendera gy'Obwetwaze.
answer_b: Zimba olubaawo lw'empapula oluliko ebifaananyi n'ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku bazira b'Obwetwaze.
answer_c: Teeka Ebifaananyi Ebiri ku mutimbagano nga byamirundi esatu nga bigyayo ebirowoozo bya banoonyi bobwetowaze
answer_d: Kola akatambi nga ka ddakiika bbiri ng'ozzaawo ekimu ku bintu ebyaliwo mu kiseera ky'Obwetwaze.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu “Enkola y’ebyobufuzi mu Chile”, ateekateeka essomo mw’anaakolera ku musingi gw’obukiikirizi era n’awa ebyokulabirako by’ebifo ebirondeddwa akalulu k’abantu bonna, n’ekigendererwa abayizi be aba 6 oba 7 okutegeera “Obukulu bw’okulonda kw’abantu bonna eri enteekateeka y’eddembe ly’eggwanga lya Chile”. answer_b: Bannyonyola omugaso gw'obuyinza obulondeddwa okusalirawo ebirungi by'olukale.
answer_c: Batottola emigaso emikulu egy'obuyinza okukkiikirira abantu nga okulonda nga kuwedde.
answer_d: Baawa eby'okulabirako eby'enjawulo eby'okwetaba mu demokulasiya ebibaawo ku bantu bekyalo era mu buwangaaliro bwange

question: Abayizi mu siniya ey'okusatu balina okukiikirira engeri ebyafaayo by'omulembe ogwa kati gye byagenda bitondeka okusinziira ku mulembe omukulu ow'ebyafaayo Eric Hobsbawm gwe yassaawo, nga bakola olukalala lw'ebiseera. question: Ku nkomerero y’ekibiina ekikwata ku “Enkola y’Akatale,” omusomesa akola okukebera okw’omukutu okumanya oba abayizi be bategeera ebintu ebireetawo enkyukakyuka mu bwetaavu bw’ekintu. answer_a: José: Emyaka nga ebiri emabega, nnali nzimba caaka za chocolate ku kiyosiki ky’essomero, naye okuva etteeka lwe lyakyuka, kati nzirina okuzigula wabweru n’okuzireeta mu nsawo yange ey’omukono.
answer_b: Claudia: Wiiki ewedde twagenda ku mizannyo n'abakozi baffe, naye olw'okuba twakererewa, tetwasobola kufuna tiketi, kwe kusalawo okukozesa ssente ku pizza ne sandwiichi.

answer_d: Ignacio: Okutuusa omwaka oguwedde, nnali nkolaasa ssente ze bampa ku byuma ebikwata ku alubaamu, naye kati olw’okuba sikyagala alubaamu, nterekera ssente ezo okuzikozesa ku kintu ekirala.

question: Omusomesa oluvannyuma lw'okukola kitundu"Ensengeka y'enfuga yamateeka ", okunnyonyola mulimu ki ogunamuyamba okuzuula oba abayizi be aba siniya ey'okuna basobola okutegeera emisingi ebikola mu nteekateeka yamateeka.ku bikola wammanga guliwa ogunabasobozesa okukunganya obujulizi okwekeneenya ekigendererwa ky'ekiruubirirwa?

answer_d: Enjawulo ku bukulu bw’okwetaba mu kulonda mu kutondawo eggwanga

question: Omusomesa ow’ekinaana akuŋŋaanya abayizi mu bibinja n’abasaba okunoonya amawulire ku yintaneeti agakwata ku butonde bw’ensi obusangibwa mu Chile. question: Mu kibiina kya 'kindagateni/nasale', omusomesa agenda kukozesa okwetegereza ng'ekyakukozesebwa okukebera okuyiga kw'abaana abato okusinziira ku biragiro bino ebikwata ku mutima gw'okutegeera embeera z'obuwangwa n'obulamu: Anyumya ku bikolwa eby'omumulembe mu kitundu kyabwe. question: Omusomesa akola ku ntandikwa y’ekivvulu ky’obufuzi eky’omu 1973 n’abayizi be ab’ekitongole eky’omukaaga. Omu ku bo amuyimiriza okumubuuza kino: “Omusomesa, sitegeera bw’otugamba nti: ‘Embeera eno yali nsonga y’ekivvulu ky’obufuzi eri munnabyafaayo ono, naye si eri omulala.’ Kati, Abamerika baalina obuyinza bungi ku kivvulu ky’obufuzi eky’omu 1973? Yee oba nedda?”. Kiki ekikyamu ekiyinza okutegeerwa okuva mu kibuuzo ky’omuyizi kino ekikwata ku byafaayo, ng’essomo?
answer_a: Okukendeeza ebyafaayo ne bibeera ng’ebikwata ku nkola za bweru eze ggwanga.

question: Omusomesa ku mutendera ogwoomunaana akola n'ekitongole 'The Rise of National Monarchies' ekigendereddemu okuleeta obukugu mu kusoma wamu n'okuzuula obusinge,mu ngeri ey'enjawulo,okwesigika kw'ensonda nga ofumitiiriza okuteeka esssira ku ebyo ebisomesebwa eby'ebyafaayo.Nga amaliriza asaba okubasomera obusinge buno: Teri muntu n'omu asobola kugaana maanyi ga bakabaka agakula nge by'enfuna ebikozessebwa ne obunene bw'amagye bweyongera. Newankubadde etteeka teriri kukuuma abafugibwa bokka wamu n'obuyinza bwa amateeka ga abalangira. Bannamateeka be bamu ku abantu ab'enkizo abbakola ennongosereza mu bwakabaka. Era nga kino kyeyolekera mu mawanga agalina obkugu mu mateeka ge mirindira gyaago giva mu mateeka ga Rooma ey'edda.(The Europe of Reformation. 1517-1559, Elton Geoffrey(1999).) Ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekigenda okukulaakulanya butereevu okwekeneenya obwesigwa bwe ensibuko ya abayizi gye baakola?
answer_a: Okakasa ekika ky'ensibuko, oba ya ntandikwa oba ya bubiri, okusinziira ku mwaka we yasindikiddwa.
answer_b: Tegeera Elton Geoffrey bw’ali n’ekigendererwa kye bwe yali awandiika ensibuko.
answer_c: Laga obumanyifu bw'omuwandiisi ku byafaayo by'obwakabaka bw'amawanga.
answer_d: Ekitabo kino bwe kigamba ku maanyi ga kabaka kiyamba kitya okutegeera okukula kw’obwakabaka obw’eggwanga?

question: Omusomesa ategeka okulabiriza egyemirundi essatu,nga akozesa ousinge, okusobola okuyamba abayizi abbali mu siniya eyookubiri  okutegera ensibuko ye endowooza ezakozesewa bakirimaanyi mu lutalo olunnyoggoga; era mu ngeri y'emu bateeseteese emirimu mingi. Ngeri ki ku mirimu egiweereddwa enaasobozesa abayizi okutuukiriza ekirubirirwa kyabwe?
answer_a:
1: Ku maapu y’ebyafaayo eraga ekiseera ky’olutalo olw’ebbanga, balaga ebifo we waaliwo obutabanguko obw’amaggye obutali butereevu wakati w’amawanga amanene.

2: Bwe bamala okubigattira awamu, balonda lumu ku ntalo ezo ze balaze ne boogera ku nkyukakyuka ze zaleeta mu byobufuzi n’ensonga z’ensi.

3: Bakola akatonnyeze akalaga entalo ezo, nga balaga obuwanguzi n’ebigwi bya buli limu ku mawanga amanene mu ntalo ezo.
answer_b:
1: Balambula ebipande bya propaganda okuva mu US ne USSR, nga bagerageranya embeera mwe byakolerwa, ekigendererwa, n'ebirala.

2: Bwegattira awamu, balonda kimu ku byamaguzi eby'amaanyi era bakola ekipande ekikikiikirira.

3: Bategeka olukung'aana n'ebipande wansi w'omutwe "USA vs USSR," okusalawo okuyita mu kulonda obuyinza obusukkulumu bwali bwa ani.
answer_c:
1: Balambulula ebiwandiiko okuva mu bitongole by'obukessi ebikulu ebya buli ggwanga (KGB ne CIA), nga bategeera ebigendererwa byabyo.

2: Nga batadde wamu, bakola ekiwandiiko ekiraga mu bwangu ensonga eziweereddwa buli kitongole ku ngeri gye kikolamu emirimu gyakyo.

3: Bakola akatabo akageraageranya buli pulaani y'ebyobufuzi ebitongole by'obukessi eby'amawanga gegezaako okutaasa.
answer_d:
1: Beebuuza ku mitimbagano gy'enternet okunoonya ensibuko z'ebikwata ku nkola enkulu ez'eby'amagye amaanyi agaalina mu kiseera ky'olutalo olw'ebbanga.

2: Bwe bamala okubikuŋŋaanya, basoma ensibuko ezo ne bafuna endowooza enkulu eza buli emu.

3: Baleeta endowooza zaabwe mu maaso g'ekibiina, nga balaga enjawulo n'obufaananyi mu nkola ezaakozesebwa buli limu ku maanyi ago.

question: Omusomesa, mu kitundu ekiyigiriza ku Nkomerero y'olutalo olusirise, yategeka omukolo eri abayizi be aba 10 okwetegefuza okwekenneenya ensibuko enkulu. Olw'ensonga eno, yabaleetera okusoma n'okuddamu ebibuuzo nga basinziira ku katundu kano okuva mu kitabo ekyawandiikibwa omuntu ku bulamu bwe: Entandikwa y'endowooza ya "perestroika" yali kukakasa okw'amaanyi nti tetuyinza kuddamu kubeerawo nga bwe twali. Mbadde nkyogera ku kino emirundi mingi era ssigezaako kuddamu kukyogera wano. Sijjuddeko, wadde akatundu akatono, nti nze nnali ntandisi w'enkyukakyuka ey'amaanyi mu bulamu bw'eggwanga lyaffe. Ebyajjira mu butangaavu ku byafaayo byaffe, nga byebaziddwa "glasnost," byakakasa mu ngeri ey'obukambwe n'etakyuka nti enkola eyakolebwa okusinziira ku mitindo gy'obukangavvu n'obufuzi bw'ekinnakyemalira tekyali kigumiikirizika, si lwa nsonga za mpisa zokka, wabula era n'olw'ensonga z'omusingi z'eggwanga mu by'enfuna n'eby'embeera z'abantu. Kyali kisindise eggwanga ku nkomerero era ne kiteeka ku kizingo ky'obuziba. Era kyagenda mu maaso okubaawo okuyita mu maanyi, eby'obulimba, okutya, obutafaayo bw'abantu, wamu n'obuyambi obw'omusaayi ogw'ekinnakyemalira ogwasaasaanya ebyobugagga era ne gunafuya obusobozi bw'ebiseera eby'omu maaso. The August Coup. The Truth and its Consequences, Mikhail Gorbachev. Kino kye kimu ku bibuuzo ebyaddiddwa omuyizi nga basinziira ku mutundu oguli waggulu: Kiki ekyali kifaanaanyi ekiri mu mbeera mwe biteekeddwawo enkola za Perestroika ne Glasnost mu eyali USSR? Perestroika: okukkiriza nti omuntu tasobola kuddamu kubeerawo nga bwe yali. Glasnost: nkola eyakolebwa okusinziira ku mitindo gy'obukangavvu n'obufuzi bw'ekinnakyemalira nga tekikyali kigumiikirizika. Bunafu ki obulabika mu kuddamu kw'omuyizi, ku bikwata ku busobozi okutaputa ensibuko?
answer_a: Kiwa eky’okunnyonnyola ensibuko okuva mu ndaba y’omuntu ku lulwe.
answer_b: byekeneenya enziramu ku bintu ebitalina kyakudamu.
answer_c: Essira ku kunnyonnyola ensibuko y'ebigambo awatali kubuusabuusa ku biteeso byayo.
answer_d: Eleeta ennyingo ezinnyonnyola ebiri mu bigambo by'omuwandiisi nga tolowoozeza ku ky'abadde aluubirira.

question: Mu kibiina kya musanvu, mu somo erikwata ku Myaka wakati, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa: "Okukulaakulanya okutegeera ebyafaayo nga twawula enkolagana z’ensalo wakati w’Abakristaayo, Abasiraamu, n’Abayudaaya mu kibuga ky’e Iberian." Okutuukiriza kino, asaba abayizi okukola olugero olulaga enkolagana ezaaliwo mu kiseera ekyo. Bw’aba ng’alondoola omulimu guno, akiraba nti abayizi bangi tebategedde bulungi nkolagana z’ensalo wakati w’Abasiraamu, Abakristaayo, n’Abayudaaya. Ng’ekyokulabirako, asanga emirimu mingi egirimu ebintu ebifaanana bino: "Erinnya lyange nze Muhamed, ndi Musiraamu omuto abeera mu Bufuzi bw’Abasiraamu obwa Cordoba, famire yange yonna egoberera eddiini y’Obusiraamu era tutunda emikeeka mu katale. Tetukolagana na Bakristaayo wadde Abayudaaya kubanga bakaafiiri." Nga twetegereza obujulizi obukuŋŋaanyiziddwa, mulimu ki omupya omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi okukwasaganya ekigendererwa ekyateesebwa, ng’asinga kwesigama ku kukulaakulanya okutegeera ebyafaayo?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola buli omu ku lwabwe bw’alowoza abantu abaabeeranga ku lukalu lwa Iberian bwe baabeeranga era nga bwe bakolagananga, ng’osinziira ku kulaba ebifaananyi.
answer_b: Mu bibinja, mukiikirire embeera ez’enjawulo ez’obumu ezabangawo mu kibuga kya Iberian Peninsula, nga musinziira ku biwandiiko by’abantu ab’enjawulo abaakibeeramu.
answer_c: Maliriza chati ku bikwata ku nzikiriza z’amadiini ez’abantu abaabeera mu kitundu kya Iberian Peninsula, nga osinziira ku kusoma ekitabo ekikulungamya, ng’olambulula engeri gye zaakosa enkolagana yaabwe.
answer_d: Weebale okutangaaza enkolagana eziriwo wakati w'Abakristaayo n'Abasiraamu nga tusinziira ku mawulire agali ku yintaneeti, ng'olaga obufaananagana n'enjawulo ku ebyo ebyaliwo ku lukalu lwa Iberian mu myaka gy'enkulakulana.

question: Mulimu ki ku gikuweredwa  wammanga, ogutumbula obukugu bw’abayizi mu kukebera ensibuko z’ebyanjuliziddwa?
answer_a: Bakyalira eterekero lyebintu ebikadde eriri mu mwoleso gwebintu byabazumgu ebyobuwangwa
answer_b: Balonda ebifaananyi ebikwaata ku nnono z'eggwanga okuva mu bizinga by'ebifaananyi by'amawanga ag'enjawulo.
answer_c: Babuuza abantu abava mu nsi ez’enjawulo ne boolekera bannaabwe mu kibiina empisa enkulu ez’ennono z’ensi ezo.
answer_d: Bakola pposita ezikwata ku ngeri z’okugattika enzikiriza z’abantu abava mu mawanga amalala nga basinziira ku bifaananyi eby’enjawulo era ne bazireeta mu kibiina.

question: Mutendera ki omusomesa gwalina okusooka okulaga abayizi mu kibiina ekyesigamiziddwa ku kuyiga ku puloojekiti?
answer_a: Leetayo era okole ku kibuuzo ku ekyo oba ekizibuuzo kimu.
answer_b: nnyonyola amakulu g’ebiruubirirwa by’okuyiga n’ebivaamu.
answer_c: Kola okunoonyereza ku mbeera y'obuyiiya mu puloojekiti ez'enjawulo
answer_d: kulemberamu mu kuzuula ebintu ebitananoonyerezebwako bayizi .

question: Soma embeera eno: Abayizi abali mu S.6 bamaze okuzuula ekizibu mu ssomero lyabwe: tewaliwo we basobola okugula emmere ennungi ey’akawungeezi mu kiseera ky’okuwummula(obudde bwa buleeke). Okuddamu, bawadde ekirowoozo ky’okuzimba ka kiyosiki akatunda ebibala ne yogati, nga bakaddukanya bokka. Bayinza kukolagana na somo ki okutumbula pulojeketi eno?
answer_a: Mu by'obuyiiya, okuyambako n'obumanyirivu mu nkola y'ebyamamawulire mu kutondekawo akabonero (logo) okubamanyisa.
answer_b: Mu essomo ly'Ekibalangulo, okukola okunoonyereza okw'ekibalangulo okusobola okuzuula omuwendo gw'abayizi abaagala emmere ennungi eri obulamu.
answer_c: Mu by'Obulamu, okukebera ebiriisa n'amaanyi agali mu by'emmere ebitundibwa.
answer_d: Nga tukozesa okusomesa kw’ebyemizannyo, twongere ku mulamwa gw’emmere ennungi n’okukola dduyiro.

question: Ekibiina ky'abayizi kiraze omusomesa waakyo owa tekinologye nti baagala okuyiga ku nkola y'okukola pulogulaamu za kompyuta kyokka ne balaga nti tebamanyi ngeri gye banaatandikaamu omulimu guno kubanga bagutwala nga mugumu nnyo. Kintu ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okukubiriza abayizi n'okubanguyiza okuyiga essomo lino?
answer_a: Okwanjula abayizi eri empandiika y'ennimi za kompyuta pulogulaamu ze bamanyi era ze bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo.
answer_b: Okwanjula abayizi eri ennimi z'okukoodinga ze bamanyi, gamba nga Java, C++, oba PHP
answer_c: Okwanjula abayizi ebyokulabirako bya simulators ebiwagira okutegeera enkozesa ya data ow'olunyiriri
answer_d: Okwanjula abayizi eri ebintu ebikulu ebikozesebwa mu kuwandika pulogulaamu, gamba nga aligolizimu, nga bikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.

question: Okuddamu ebyetaago by'obuwangaliro, abayizi ku mutendera ogw'omunaana bakola entebe mu kifo abaana ba pulayimale we bazannyira ku ssomero. Ng'olowooza ku mbeera ennyonyoddwa, misingi ki egyokweken'eenya omusomesa gy'alina okutunuulira nga yetegeereza ekintu ekitondeddwa abayizi okusinziira ku bafunye obuyambi?
answer_a: Okukozesa ebintu ebitagasa nnyo oba ebintu ebyakakozesebwa, bityo okukendeeza ku nsaasaanya y'ebintu.
answer_b: Okukozesa ebintu ebiddamu okukozesebwa oba ebyo ebirina obuzibu bw’obutonde bw’ensi obutono oluvannyuma lw’obulamu bw’entebe obw’omugaso
answer_c: Okulonda ebintu ebimala ebbanga era nga binywevu ebisobozesa okukola ebintu eby’enjawulo ebiyamba entebe okuba enkalubo n’okunywevu.
answer_d: Okukozesa ebintu ebikkiriza okubaawo kw'endabika ennungamu etuukana n'empisa z'essomero.

question:
Mu kibiina kya Tekinologiya, abayizi ab'ekibiina ekyotutaano
bali mu kuzimba akamotoka mu dizaayini zaabwe, nga bakozesa ebintu eby'enjawulo , ng'ebimu bilimu n'okusala ebintu.
Kiragiro ki ekisooka omusomesa ky'asaanidde okuwa abayizi basobole okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebisala obulungi?
answer_a: Tegeka ekifo weegenda okusalira nga tonnatandika kusala.
answer_b: Londa ekintu ekikaluba era ekyenkanankana okusalako ebintu.
answer_c: Laba nti ebikozesebwa biri mu mbeera nnungi era nga birina obuwaze obutereevu.
answer_d: Londa ekyuma ekisala okusinziira ku mulimu n'ebintu by'ogenda okukozesa.

question: Okusinziira ku mbeera ennyonnyoddwa, engeri ki ey'okusomesa esinga okuba entuufu abayizi okuyiga okumanya engeri ekifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu gye kikosezzaamu abantu?
answer_a: Leeta ebifaananyi ebiraga oba ebintu ebirala ebiraga engeri kazambi ono gy’akosaobutonde bw’ensi, era okusinziira ku kino, olonde ebirungi ebiri mu kifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu mu kitundu.
answer_b: Bawe abaana abali ku mutindo ogw’oku Intaneeti ogw’ebibuuzo n’okunoonyereza okusobola okukozesebwa ku bantu abangi, era mwembi mukole ku nsonga ez’okwebuuzaako okusobola okuzuula ebinavaamu ekifo ekiddamu okukozesa ebintu mu kitundu.
answer_c: Zimba ekifaananyi ekiraga abayizi nga beekubaganya ebirowoozo era nga balaga obubi obuva mu kika ky'akasasiro kano, n'obulungi obuli mu kuddamu okukozesa ebintu by'ekika kino okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuleeta obulamu obulungi mu kitundu.
answer_d: Noonyereza wamu n'abayizi ku bikozesebwa bya TIC ebisobola okukozesebwa okwebuuza ku bantu abali okumpi n'essomero, okukung'aanya ebirowoozo byabwe ku bukulu bw'okuba n'ekifo ky'okuddamu okukozesa ebintu ebiyoonoonwa ebiri mu maka.

question: Mu kiseera ky'okukulaakulanya pulojekiti y'obuweereza ebibinja by'emirimu mu masomero ga siniya era balaga ebizibu ebiddiringana eri omusomesa waabwe eyali abakulembedde. Era okuddamu omu ku bo, omusomessa abawa amagezi okutegeka ekipande kya Gantt. Ku magezi agaweereddwa waggulu olowooza kusoomoza ki ekibinja kino kye kwasanga?
answer_a: Ebikozesebwa bye twetaaga okukulaakulanya obuweereza bwaffe tebikwatagana na byo bye tulina.
answer_b: Tulina ebifo bingi eby'amawulire ebiri ku mukutu ogwa Web kyokka tetumanyi kye kigenda okuba eky'omugaso ku buli mulimu.
answer_c: Waliwo emirimu mingi gye tulina okukola era tweraliikirira okubula obwesimbu, okusaanyawo obudde obutono bwe tulina okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa.
answer_d: Ekizibu kye twazuula kirina engeri ez’enjawulo ezisobola okugonjoolwa, twetaaga akabonero akatuyamba okusalawo engeri esinga okuba entuufu.

question: Mu kibiina kya tekinologiya mu ssomero lya Middle,omutendera gw'okukola dizaayini eyoobuweereza gukoleddwako. omusomesa yabuuza ebibinja by'emirimu okwolesa okusobola okulaga enkulaakulana mu mutendera guno ogwa pulojekiti. Enkola ya pulojekiti eno,makulu ki agwolesa nga ekibiina mu mutendera gwo okukola dizayini?
answer_a: Okukolera awamu, nga mulaga obweteefu bw’ekibiina n’obwesigwa okufuna ebiteeso n’endowooza okuva eri banno ku mulimu gwammwe.
answer_b: Okwekenneenya obukulu bw'enteekateeka ya ssente ezikozeseddwa okutuusa kati n'okuteekateeka enkyukakyuka ezigenda okusobozesa okutuukiriza ebigendererwa by'omulimu guno.
answer_c: Okukola omulimu ogw’omugaso mu kuteesa okw’okulambulula ensonga ez’obuwaze ezaakolebwa mu kutuukiriza omulimu okusinziira ku bigendererwa by’omulimu ogwo.
answer_d: Okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nkulaakulana mu nteekateeka ya serivisi, okufuna endowooza y’ebibiina byonna n’okugattako obulungi obutongole okusinziira ku kiruubirirwa ekyasooka.

question: Omukulu w’essomero atunuulidde okweyongera okunene mu kukozesa amazzi era n’ategeeza abasomesa b’essomero ekyo. Omusomesa w’ebyuma ow’ekibiina kya II Medio asalawo okuleeta ekizibu kino eri abayizi be, mu mutwe gw’ekitabo “Okutereeza enkozesa y’ebintu”, nga alina ekigendererwa eky’okunoonya eby’okukola okumalawo ekizibu ekyo. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku guyinza okusobozesa abayizi okuwa eby’okukola okumalawo ekizibu ekyo?
answer_a: Nnonyezereza ku byokulabirako eby’engeri endala ez’okukozesaamu amazzi obuvunaanyizibwa mu mbeera z’ebyenjigiriza endala ebisobola okukoppebwa mu ssomero
answer_b:
Ebiragiro Ekkumi Eby’Okukendeeza n’Okukuuma Enkozesa y’Amazzi mu Ssomero:

1. Tegeka enkola y’okukozesa amazzi mu ssomero lyonna era oginyweze.
2. Londa akakiiko k’abayizi akakwasisa empenda z’okukozesa amazzi mu ngeri entuufu.
3. Longoosezza amazzi agava mu nkuba era ogakozese mu ngeri endala nga okunaabiriza ebinaabiro.
4. Kozesa ebikozesebwa ebiketereza amazzi nga omuliifu ezitakozesa mazzi mangi.
5. Ziba engira zonna ezitonnya mangu ddala.
6. Gamba abantu bonna ku bubaka obw’okukendeeza amazzi nga oyita mu bubaati n’ebitabo by’essomero.
7. Tegeka empaka z’okukendeeza amazzi wakati w’ebibiina by’abayizi.
8. Fundiza ebimera by’oku ssomero mu makya oba akawungeezi okwewala amazzi okwanguwa okukala.
9. Kozesa amazzi agakoleddwa okunaaba engoye okunaabiriza ebinaabiro.
10. Yigiriza abayizi n’abakozi bonna ku bukulu bw’okukuuma amazzi n’engeri y’okukikola.
answer_c: Kaweefube ow’okukozesa amazzi obulungi n’engeri obutakikola bwe kiyinza okukosa ensi yonna, era n’omu ssomero, mukulu nnyo. Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku nsonga eno.
answer_d: Kebera engeri amazzi gye gakozesebwa mu bifo eby'enjawulo mu ssomero okusobola okuzuula wekitandise ekizibu.

question: Omusomesa yeetaaga okulonda akakodyo akookusomesa kozesa enkozesa enzibu, ngayesigamye ku bintu ebikozesa amasanyalaze.Ekinene ennyo asuubira abayizi be okuyiga okukozesa ebintu ebyo nga basinzira ku kwekuuma saako naabo abali mukukola. answer_a: Ebigambo ebikulembera
answer_b: Omusomo ogw'enkaliriza
answer_c: Ebilabibwaako ebirambike.
answer_d: Okugonjoola ebizibu

question: Ki ku tekinologiya ono wammanga asobola okulaga omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okutaano engeri  enkulaakulana ya tekinologiya gy'atuukirizaamu ebyetaago by'abantu?
answer_a: Okuvumbula bbaatule ey'obutonde esobola okuddamu okukola amasannyalaze, nga kino kikola ku bwetaavu bw'okutereka amasannyalaze
answer_b: Okukola jaketi eriko amasannyalaze ga  enjuba(sola) agasobozesa okukola amasannyalaze, nga kino kikola ku bwetaavu bw'okuzza obuggya amasimu
answer_c: Okutondawo ekyuma ekisobola okuddamu okukozesa empapula z'omu woofiisi ezikozeseddwa ne zifuuka empapula z'ekinaabiro, nga kikola ku bwetaavu bw'okukozesa obulungi eby'obugagga
answer_d: Okukulaakulanya ebimera ebisobola okufulumya ekitangaala awatali bbugumu, nga kikola ku bwetaavu bw'okukozesa obulungi eby'obugagga

question:
Abasomesa b'ebya tekinologiya n'ebya sayansi mu kibiina eky'okutaano bakkiriziganyizza okukolera awamu ku nsonga eno ey'ebya sayansi: okukula kw'ekimera. Okusobola okukola kino, omusomesa wa tekinologiya asabye abayizi be okukola okwanjula okunnyonnyola enkola eno, okusobola okunyweza okumanya kwe bafunye mu sayansi, era n'okwongerezaako, okukola eby'okuyiga eri abayizi b'ekibiina eky'okusatu, abalina okuyiga enkola eno.
Ku bintu bino ebya digito wamanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukozesa okukola okwanjula kuno, okusinziira ku kigendererwa n'omutindo gw'abayizi?
answer_a: PowerPoint, nga tukozesa ebiwandiike n'ebifaananyi
answer_b: Movie Maker, okukwata n'okulongoosa vidiyo
answer_c: AnimatorDV, Okukozesa omukutu gwa AnimatorDV, okukola eby'okulabirako mu ngeri ya Katuuni
answer_d: Padlet, Okukozesa omukutu gwa Padlet, okufulumya ebintu ebikozesebwa okutegeera enkola.

question: Abayizi mu kibiina eky’okutaano babadde bakola ku mutwe ogwogera ku kigendererwa ky’okuyiga “Okukola ebintu ebya tekinologiya okugonjoola ebizibu, nga bakebera era nga bakyusa ebintu.” Babadde balina okulonda ebizibu ebitagonjoleddwa mu maka gaabwe era ne balonda ekintu ekimu, nga bwe kikyusiddwa, kiyinza okubigonjoola. Balina okwanjula ebyava mu mulimu gwabwe eri ekibiina okufuna ebirowoozo okuva eri bannaabwe. Mu bigambo bino wammanga, biliwa  ebituukirawo okuteekebwa mu mulamwa gw’okukebera ogukozesebwa abayizi okuwa bannaabwe ebirowoozo ku kutuukiriza ekigendererwa?
answer_a: Balonda ekintu ekisobola okukola ku bwetaavu obulambuluddwa mu maka. Bawa amagezi ku nkyukakyuka mu kintu ekyo nga bakozesa ebifaananyi oba dayagulaamu.
answer_b: Balondoola eky’okukola okugonjoola obwetaavu obulabiddwa mu maka. Batuuma era bannyonnyola ebikolwa ebyetaagisa okutereeza ekintu eky’omulembe.
answer_c: Batuuma era ne bannyonnyola emitendera egyetaagisa okukolebwa okutereeza ekintu ekya tekinologiya. Balonda era ne bannyonnyola engeri egenda okukozesebwa okutereeza ekintu ekyo.
answer_d: Balondoola ebyo ebivaamu nga tukozesa ebintu byobutonde n'engeri gye bikosa abantu. Balonda ebikozesebwa n'ebyuma ebyetaagisa buli kitundu ky'ekintu kye bagenda okukyusa.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Kikolwa ki ku binno ekitambulira awamu nebisomesebwa n'okulowooza okwenjawulo ku ssomo lya tekinologiya ?
answer_a: Abayizi banonyereza obukakafuokuva munsonda ezitari zimu ne ku mitimbaganno ku bikwaata ku bwengula  , no'kwawula ku biwakanibwa by'ekileetawo ku bubaka bwe'kinasaayansi obuliwo.

Abayizi bakola olukalala lw'ensonga eziyinza okuba nga zasindikiriza obufere era kyekanyizibwe mu byabulijo, ebyensimbi, nebipimo bya tekinologiya .

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina kya P6 ayagala okuyigiriza abayizi be endowooza z’obugulumivu, endabika, n’enteekateeka, basobole okukiikirira ebintu bye bateekateeka mu bifaananyi. Ku bikolwa by’omusomesa bino wammanga, kiki ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okutegeera enkola y’okukola endowooza ezo?
answer_a: Saba abayizi balowoole entebe nga "etengejja" mu nsonda y'ekisenge era bagimulisize nga kikwatagana butereevu ku bisenge n'ettaka. Laga nti ebisiikirize ebirabika bikwatagana n'endaba . Oluvannyuma, babuuze ebibuuzo bino: ndaba meka eziriwo? Nkwatagana ki elli wakati waazo?
answer_b: Saba abayizi okukuba obufananyi ku ndabika enkulu ey'ekintu oba ekitundu era balonde ekisiikirize ekituufu ku buli kintu ekyegolodde, okufaanana ezo eziri mu kibiina. Oluvannyuma, balage nti endege ezo ziyitibwa eey'obugulumivu, endege y'enteekateeka, n'endege y'ekifaananyi, ng'ebifaananyi ebisiigiddwa ku buli emu ye ndabika y'obugulumivu.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola abayizi nti ebifananyi ebiragibwa by’ekintu biyitibwa ndaba, kubanga buli kifaananyi ekiragibwa kifaananira ddala endaba gye twandibadde nayo ku kintu ekyo singa tukitunuulira nga tuli wala nnyo, nga tukozesa lensi ey’amaanyi ennyo, mu bwangu bw’emisaana egiraga.
answer_d: Buuza abayizi: Ekintu kirina endabaazi mmeka? Endabaazi mmeka ku zino ze twetaaga okukiikirira ekintu? Oluvannyuma, nnyonnyola nti byonna bisinga kwesigama ku kifo ekintu we kiri okutunuulira ennyanguyirizi ezisiiga ebifaananyi, era nti mu nkola ekintu kirina okuteekebwa mu kifo eky’engeri eyo nti obwenyi bwakyo obusinga obungi buba bugendagana oba butunuulidde ennyanguyirizi ezo.

question: Mu kwogera na abayizi mu mutendera gwe ekibiina eky'omunaana, ku nsonga ekwata ku nkosa  y'ebigonjoola ebizibu bya tekinologiya era omusomesa ayanjula endowooza y'okuteekateeka okukaddiwa (PO), okunnyonyola ku buvune obuva mu kwegeranyizibwa kw'ebikozesebwa by'amateeka ga tekinologiya. Nga boogera ku ngeri y'okukwatamu ekintu ekisuubirwa okubeerawo, abayizi balaga okubuusabuusa kwabwe era bawa endowooza zaabwe ku butya bwe kiyinza okuba ekizibu okuzza emabega omuze gwa okutwalira awamu ogw'okufulumya n'okutunda mu bungi. Mu nyinnyonyola z'omusomesa wammanga eriwa eyandigonjodde obweralirikivu bwa bayizi era n'enkulaakulanya obukugu obusuubirwa okukuzibwa mu ssomo
answer_a: “Mazima ddala, ekintu kya PO kitulaga nti enkulaakulana y’ebyuma erina obubi bwayo ku mitendera egy’enjawulo era tekiyinza kulowoozebwa ng’ekintu kirungi kyokka nga tetubuuza bibuuzo, oba tujja kuba tuleeta okwonooneka kw’obutonde obutalikyuka.”
answer_b: “Okuva kino bwe kizibu ky’ensi yonna, kyeyoleka bulungi nti obweteefu bw’amawanga gonna bwetaagisa okukigonjoola; n’olwekyo, tuteekwa okussaayo omwoyo ku nkiiko ez’enjawulo ezibaawo ezinaatusobozesa okukola endagaano ku mutendera gw’ensi yonna.”
answer_c: "Akatale tekakola kokka, kaddamu eri ebyetaago by'abaguzi, era ekizibu kino kiraga nti tulina okwekenneenya n'okuddamu okwetegereza empisa zaffe ez'okukozesa ebintu okulaba engeri gye twenyigiramu mu muzingo guno omubi n'engeri gye tusobola okugukyusaamu."
answer_d: "N'olwekyo obukulu bw'ebibiina okubeera abakulembeza enkyukakyuka, ng'ebibiina by'abantu abalwanirira eddembe bwe bikola nga byolesa obuzibu buno eri abantu bonna, abakulembeze balyoke bakole ekintu, ng'ekyokulabirako ekibiina kya SOP (Awataaliiwo Kukaddiwa Kutegekeddwa)."

question: Abayizi ba siniya baali mu nteekateeka yo okukola pulojekiti yaabwe. Era okutuukiriza enteekateeka yaabwe, omusomesa asalawo okubayamba okuyiga engeri y'okukola  ebifanaanyi bya PERT, nga balina okutandika enkolagana ezeetengeredde  mu mirimu okusobola okussa mu nkola pulojekiti yaabwe. Ku nkomerero y'okusomesa mu kibiina omusomesa asalawo okwekkeneenya entegeera ya bayizi ku bifanaanyi wamu no omugaso gwabyo okutereza enteekateeka y'okusoma okunaddako mu kibiina okusinziira ebinaaba biddiddwamu. Ku bikozesebwa bino wammanga kiki ekisoboseza omusomesa okukungannya amangu eri mu ngeri entuufu amawulire agakwata ku kutegeera kw'abayizi n'omugaso gw'ebifanaanyi bya PERT?
answer_a: Omuko ogw’okwekebejja omuntu ku muntu, abayizi mwe babuuliriziganya nti, “Engeri y’okuzimbamu ekibalangulo kya PERT,” ate oluvannyuma ne bakolera awamu okutereeza eby’okuddamu byabwe
answer_b: Tiketi y’okuva, ng’esaba abayizi okulaga ebintu bisatu bye bayize mu kibiina n’ebibuuzo bibiri bye bakyali nabyo ku bikwata ku dayagulaamu za PERT n’omugaso gwazo.
answer_c: Omutindo ogw'okubaza okutegeera, nga gutondeka abayizi mu bibinja okusinziira ku mutendera gw'okutegeera kwabwe okwesigamiziddwa ku by'addamu byabwe ku kibuuzo: “Ekibalanguzi kya PERT kye ki?”
answer_d: Akakodyo k’okubuuza abayizi okuddamu bye bayize ku kikwaatiriro kya PERT n’ekigendererwa kyakyo, okusinziira ku mitendera gino: “Nkimanyi bulungi; mmanyi, naye sisobola kukinyonnyola; era simanyi.”

question:
Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri mu siniya alina enteekateeka y’okuyigiriza ey’ekigendererwa “Okulaga embeera ez’enjawulo eziva mu nkulaakulana y’tekinologiya aliwo kati, ezireetawo enkyukakyuka ennungi oba embi mu bulamu bw’omuntu, mu mbeera z’abantu, obutonde bw’ensi, amateeka, ebyenfuna, oba mu bintu ebirala.” Ku somo erisooka, bagenda kwetegereza ekigendererwa kino: “Okuteebereza ebiriva mu nkulaakulana y’ebyuma ezaayita.”
Ku mirimu gino wamanga, mirimu ki ogusobola okuyamba omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’agenda okukolerako mu somo erisooka?
answer_a: Laga abayizi vidiyo eraga engeri ebintu eby'obuyiiye n'enkulakulana ez'ebika bya tekinologiya , ebimu ku bitusuuseewo ku nsi, oluvannyuma obasabe okulaga ebyo ebikoze bubi okusinga.
answer_b: Nyonyola abayizi ku  bilungi n'ebibi by'akabonero ka kampasi (compass) , oluvannyuma obasabe okunoonyereza ku bintu ebirala ebitaddewo embeera okusinziira ku kino.
answer_c: Laga abayizi vidiyo ekwata ku kyuma ekikozesa omukka n’engeri gye kyakyukaamu ne kireetawo ebiyiye ebipya. Oluvannyuma obabuulire okwogera ku bintu ebyaleetebwawo okukula kwakyo okw’eddaala ku ddaala.
answer_d: Laga abayizi engeri ekintu kya teekinologiya gye kyatondebwawo, gamba nga telegulaafu(telegraph), n’engeri gye kikosezzaamu embeera z’abantu mu kiseera kino. Oluvannyuma, basabe okumaliliza ekyaati nga balaga emiganyulo n’obubi bwabyo.

question: Mu bigere by'ebyokulabirako bino wammanga ebiraga okuddamu okukozesa n'okuddamu okukola ebipya, kiki ekisobola okuyamba abayizi okwawula enjawulo wakati w'emiramwa gino?
answer_a: Kola ebintu ebirabika ng’ebisaanawo, gamba ng’okukola ekintu ekiwanirirwako ekalaamu okuva mu kasanduuko k’ebidomola, era olongoose ekintu, gamba ng’okufuula eccupa y’ebidomola okuba eky’okufukirira.
answer_b: Kozesa empapula ku njuyi zombi era oziteeke mu bifo ebirongooseddwa mu kitundu, era ojje n'ensawo yo mu supamaketi(dduuka), oleme kwetaaga ndala.
answer_c: Kola ebijimusa by'ebimera okuva mu bintu ebisigalawo ng'ebikuta by'ebibala n'ebivaavava(enva endiirwa), era kozesa ebyuma mu bujjuvu ng'okozesa omuwendo gwabyo ogusingayo
answer_d: Bbugumya era ogolole endabirwamu okukola endabirwamu oba ebimuli, n'okuwa abantu engoye ezitakozesebwa.

question: Omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'omunaana agenda kutandika pulojekiti n'abayizi be n'ekiruubirwa eky'okuwaayo obuweereza obugendereddemu abakadde mu maka nga bayambibwa essomero. Mu mutendera guno betaaga okukunganya ensonga ku batuuze ku maka gaabwe wamu n'ebyetaago byabwe. Ku mirimu egiweereddwa wammanga guliwa ogunasobozesa abayizi okuzuula ebyetaago bya buli kibinja kya bantu?
answer_a: Zimba omuti gw'ebizibu okuzuula embeera embi, ng'olaga ebintu ebigiviiriddeko n'ebigivaamu.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okukung’aanyizaamu amawulire, gamba ng’ebibuuzo n’okuyita mu kubuuza abantu, era olambike emigaso gyabyo n’obubi bwabyo.
answer_c: Noonyereza ku mukutu gwa SWOT era okomekkereze omulagirizi ku nsonga, ng'olaga amaanyi, emikisa, obunafu, n'ebintiisa.
answer_d: Lowooza ku bizibu ebiyinza okuba nga bibakosa, oluvannyuma nonde engeri z’okukungaanya amawulire.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omunaana akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku pulojekiti erimu okuzimba ekifananyi ky’amasannyalaze g’ennyumba. Bw’akebera emirimu gy’abayizi, akiraba nti ekibinja kimu tekisobolodde okukola ettaala za LED mu bisenge eby’enjawulo okukolela awamu n’okuzikirawo buli emu kuayo. Ku bikolwa bino omusomesa by’ayinza okukola, kiki ekiyinza okuyamba ekibinja kino okutegeera engeri y’okuzimbamu omutendera gw’amasannyalaze gwe beetaaga?
answer_a: Balage nti enkolagana wakati w’amatala erina okuba nga ya mugattiro (parallel) gasobole okuba nga geeyimiriddeko. Oluvannyuma, basabe bakole ekifaananyi ekiraga enkolagana eno era bagikope mu muzingo gw’ekyokulabirako.
answer_b: Landiisa engeri z’omutendera gw’amasannyalaze ogwa seriizi n’ogwa paraleli, ng’olaga nti mu gwa seriizi, amasannyalaze gakwata ekkubo limu, kale ettaala tezeeyimiridde. Oluvannyuma, basabe bakwatte ettaala mu mutendera gwa paraleli era bakebere ebijja muvvuddemu.
answer_c: Mutunule ekifaananyi ky’omulandira gw’amasannyalaze gwe bazimbye era mubannyonnyole nti okusobola amatala okukola nga tegakwatagana, galina kukwasibwa mu nkola ey’omukwanaganyo. Oluvannyuma, mbasabe bongere bakole ekifaananyi ky’amasannyalaze nga bakwasa amatala gonna okuva ku nsibuko era bazimbe omulandira gw’amasannyalaze omupya.
answer_d: Munoonyereze nabo engeri ettaala gye zeeyisaamu nga zikwasiddwa mu nsengeka eya siriizi n’eya paraleli nga muliko ezimu muziggyako. Oluvannyuma, mwekkaanye ekifaananyi ky’omukutu gw’amasannyalaze gwe bazimbye okusobola okumanya enkyukakyuka ze bagenda okukola. Mu nkomerero, mbasabe bakwasize ettaala zonna eziri mu kyoogerero okusinziira ku kifaananyi ekipya.

question: Omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'omukaaga ajja kwekkeneenya abayizi ne ebiruubirwa bino wammanga. 'Yawula eby'okugonjoola ebizibu bya tekinologiya ebiriwo era n'okuzuula ebyetaago byebazeemu mu byafaayo by'enkulaakulanya. Okusinziira ku nkola ya bayizi wammanga eriwa enasobezesa okwawula ebintu ebifuniddwa eby'ekiruubirwa ekisabiddwa omusomesa?
answer_a: Bageraageranya engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okugonjoola ebizibu ezikwatagana n’ekibinja ky’obwetaavu obumu obwateekebwawo.
answer_b: Bageraageranya ku bwetaavu obubadde buzzeewo mu bitundu eby’enjawulo eby’enkulaakulana y’embeera z’abantu n’enkyukakyuka zaabyo okuyita mu biseera.
answer_c: Bannyonnyola okufaanagana mu mbeera z'ebyafaayo ebyakozesebwa okuteekateeka ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'ekika kye kimu okumala ekiseera.
answer_d: Bageraageranya ebyetaago ebyaliwo mu kutondeka ebintu bya tekinologiya ebifaanagana okusinziira ku mulembe mwe byatondekerwa.

question:
Omusomesa aleeta eri abayizi be ab'ekibiina eky'omunaana, ng'omutwe gw'ekibiina, ebirivaamu okukozesa ekkompyuta ennyo ku by'okusoma. Oluvannyuma lw'okwanjula omutwe, asaba abayizi okunoonya ebimanyiddwa ku mutwe ogwo ku yintaneeti.
Kiki ky'ayinza okubawa ng'amagezi abayizi basobole okufuna ebimanyiddwa ebituufu ku mutwe ogwateereddwawo ku byuma eby'enjawulo ebinoonyeza ebintu ku yintaneeti?
answer_a: Noonya obuwandiike obusookerwako n'ebbanka y'ebiwandiiko endala, nga weekubira mu ezo ez'ebibiina ebimanyiddwa oba ebikiikirira, ng'osooka okufuba okulonda emikutu gyabyo egya yintaneeti emikulu okuyita mu mannya ga domini zaabyo: .org (ekibiina), .gov (gavumenti n'ebitongole byayo ebitongole) ne .edu (eby'enjigiriza). Kozesa omulamwa ogusalako bulungi ekyo ekinoonyezebwa, oba okirambike ebigambo mu kyuma ekinoonya, okusobola okukendeeza ku bivaamu.
answer_b: Tandika n'okunoonya okw'awamu, ng'okozesa ebigambo ebikwatagana, okugeza: okukozesa ekirawuli, awatali bukwakkulizo. Oluvannyuma okendeeze ku kunoonya ng'owandiika ebigambo eby'omugaso, okugeza: okukozesa ekirawuli okumala essaawa ezisukka mu 8 ez'omuddiring'anwa. Era okuteekamu eggwanga, olulimi, ebigambo ebikulu, n'ekiseera eky'okutuukanya. Teeka ebigambo mu bukwakkulizo era okozese obubonero + ne –, okwongeramu ekigambo ekikulu oba okuggyamu ebyo bye tutayagala
answer_c: Londa ekyuma ekinoonya eky'omugaso era eky'amaanyi (jjukira nti ekyuma ekinoonya gye kikoma okutuuka ku mukutu gye kikoma okukola empola). Oluvannyuma noonya obubaka ng'olonda eggwanga ly'oyagala okumanya ebikwatako n'ekitundu ky'omutwe, okugeza: ssaayansi, tekinologiya, eby'amasanyu, ebyemizannyo. Okunoonya, kozesa ebigambo ebya bulijjo, tokozesa bigambo bya nnukuta nnene oba eby'akatikiti; bw'oba ng'omanyi engeri ebigambo gye birina okulabikamu, biwandiike nga bwe birina okulabikamu nga byetooloddwa obubonero, nga birimu ebigambo byonna
answer_d: Sooka okole enteekateeka y'omulimu erimu, mu kimu ku mitendera gy'omulimu, okukuŋŋaanya n'okukungaanya eby'okulabirako ku mutwe ogunoonyerezebwako. Bw'otuuka ku mutendera guno, genda ku nsibuko z'obubaka, gamba ng'ebitabo, magazini, ebiwandiiko, n'ebiwandiiko by'oku Intaneeti, omulimu we gunoonyerezebwako. Ffaayo nnyo ku nnukuta ennene n'entono bw'oba ng'owandiika ebitundu. Ffaayo ku nnukuta ez'ennimi ez'enjawulo mu kigambo oba ebigambo ebinoonyerezebwako, okusobola okulambulula okunoonyereza n'okukendeeza ku bivaamu

question: Omusomesa owa middle school asabye abayizi be okwekenneenya engeri omulimu gwabwe gye gukoleddwamu okukakasa oba kyeyambye okugonjoola obwetaavu obwazuulwa ku ntandikwa y’omulimu. Abayizi bwe bakeenenya ebyavaamu, bakizuula nti abantu be baakolera tebalowooza nti enteekateeka yaabwe egonjodde ekizibu ekyaliwo era, kyekiva gibalemesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa omusomesa kye yali ateese. Ku bikolwa bino eby’obuyigiriza, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okuyamba abayizi okwaŋŋanga obuzibu mu kuteekateeka omulimu gwabwe?
answer_a: Baawe amagezi ge banaawa omukozesa, agamuyamba okutegeera ebintu ebyo obuweereza bye bukola obulungi.
answer_b: Bateese okukola okunoonyereza ku mawulire agafuniddwa okusobola okuzuula n'okutereeza ebitundu ebitatuukirizibwa mu nkulaakulana y'obuweereza.
answer_c: Bawe amagezi ku ngeri y’okutereezaamu obuweereza obwo obuweereddwa era mubasabe okuddamu okunoonyereza ku byetaago by’abakozesa ebituufu.
answer_d: Bakubirize okukola enkyukakyuka ez’amaanyi mu pulojekiti yaabwe era obasabe beebuze ku bakozesa emirundi emirala, nga bassa essira nnyo ku bitundu ebyali tebikulaakulanyiziddwa bulungi mu pulojekiti yaabwe.

question:
Mu kibiina kya glued 10, omusomesa akolera wamu n'abayizi ku kiruubirirwa kino: “Okutegeera obutandikwa n'amaanyi g'ebintu ebireeta obucaafu mu nampewo.” Ng'omukolo, omusomesa asaba abayizi okukolera mu bibinja okunoonyereza ku bintu ebyo n'amaanyi gaabyo, n'okuteekateeka olutindo lw'obubaka (PowerPoint presentation) nga mulimu amawulire ge bazuula. Ng'ebibinja biyanjula emirimu gyabyo, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi abasinga bamaliriza nga bagamba nti ebintu ebireeta obucaafu mu nampewo biva ku bantu bokka.

Kati mu bigambo bino omusomesa by'ayogera, ebiruwa ebiyinza okuba eby'omugaso okuyamba abayizi okutereeza emirimu gyabwe n'okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa?
answer_a: Kituufu, olaze nti ebikolwa by’abantu birina omukosa omubi nnyo ku bwengula. Wabula, mikutu ki emirala egivaamu obucaafu bw’empewo egitaliimu bikolwa bya bantu? Mikosa ki egiva mu mikutu gy’obucaafu gino?
answer_b: Obulungi obw'enjawulo, mu kwolesa kwo wasinziddeko nti ffenna tukosebwa obucaafu bw'empewo. Eky'okukola ekisigadde kwe kwongera ku kunoonyereza kuno nga tuddamu ebibuuzo ku tekinologiya ki azza obucaafu mu bbanga? Kiki ky'osobola okuteesa okukendeeza ku bukosefu bw'ebintu ebyo ebivaamu obucaafu?
answer_c: Omulimu mulungi nnyo, okirizza nti amafuta agasimbibwa mu ttaka ge nsonga enkulu evaaako obucaafu bw’empewo olw’okukozesebwa kwayo ennyo mu bikolwa by’abantu eby’enjawulo. Wabula, olowooza nti ngeri ki amafuta gano agasimbibwa mu ttaka gy’agalina ku mbeera y’obutonde n’obulamu bw’abantu? Ngeri ki ezo ngeri ezo ze tuyinza okukozesa okukendeeza ku buzibu obwo?
answer_d: Kulungi, olaze bulungi obubi bwa kaboni monoksaidi ng’ekintu ekizza omukka. Naye olina okubuuza nti omuwendo gwa kaboni monoksaidi oguva mu mmotoka z’abantu gwenkana ki ku mwonoonefu gw’omukka? Tuyinza kukendeeza tutya obungi bw’ekifulumizibwa nga tukozesa entambula y’olukale?

question: Omusomesa mwaka ogusooka ogwa siniya asaba abayizi be okukola Gantt chart okuteekateeka obuweereza bwe bagenda okukola ku ssomero. question: Ekibinja ky’abaana abakulu mu nasale kirimu abaana kkumi. Bonna batambula n’obuvumu era banyumirwa ebikolwa eby’okutambula. N’olwekyo, omusomesa ateekateeka okukwata ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: “Wegezeemu n'ebintu nga bakola ku mbeera eziriwo ddala, gamba ng’okutuuka ku bintu, okunyiga obutambi ku byuma ebivuga, okuggya ebizannyisibwa mu bintu bye biterekebwamu, okukung’aanya ebintu, n’ebirala” era “Okulaga okwagala n’okumatira nga batambula awatali buzibu mu mbeera eza bulijjo n’emizannyo”. Nga twetegerezza empisa z’ekibiina ky’abaana bano, nkola ki ey’okuyiga eyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okukwata ku bigendererwa ebyo ebirondeddwa?

answer_b: OEkkubo ly'amasannyalaze: abaana bamaliriza omusinde ogw'ebizibu eby'enjawulo, nga bagoberera enteekateeka entongole.

answer_d: Ekifo ky'ebyamazina: abaana bazannya, batambulatambula era bakolagana n'ebintu ebirabika obulungi ebiterekeddwa mu kifo.

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina ekyokusatu, mu kitundu ekikwata ku ddembe ly'abaana, yalonda ekitundu kino okuva mu lugero Omuwala Ataalina Erinnya, olwa Saúl Schkolnik, okutandika okukolera awamu n'abayizi be ku ddembe ly'okumanya ekyo ky'oli: Edda ennyo,waaliwo omuwala ataali na linnya lyonna. question: Omusomesa w'abaana abato, oluvannyuma lw'okukebera okuzuula obuzibu, ateekateeka engeri z'okusomesa ezisobozesa ekibinja ky'abalenzi n'abawala okwogera ku nneewulira zaabwe. Mu ngeri zino wammanga, y'eriwa etuukana n'ekigendererwa ky'omusomesa?

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina kya ‘kindergarten’ ategese ekibiina mu bifo eby’emizannyo era ng’ayongeddeko ebintu ebipya eby’okukozesa ebisensa, gamba ng’emmeeza z’amazzi, ekitangaala, omusenyu, n’ensigo. Nga tutunuulira omutendera gw’abayizi, engeri ki ku zino wammanga esinga okukulaakulanya obumu mu baana?

answer_c: Omusomesa assaawo amateeka agafaanagana ku ngeri y’okukozesa ebikozesebwa ebipya mu biseera by’okuzannya era abajjukiza buli kiseera okukutumbula obumu.
answer_d: Omusomesa akola enteekateeka ey’okukyusa ebibinja ng’akozesa ebibinja ebitono eby’abazannyi okwewala enkaayana n’okukutanya emirembe mu banno.

question: Omusomesa omukugu ow’Nasale  alambise ekigendererwa kino okuva ku nsibuko yw’okubaawo n’obutuuze:"Okutegeera ebikolwa ebituufu n’ebikyamu olw’okubeera awamu mu ngeri entuufu mu kibinja, ebyolekeddwa mu mbeera ez’enjawulo ezabulijjo n’emizannyo". Okutuuka ku kino, mu bbanga ly’okwogerezeganya, bateeseteese amateeka agafuga okubeera awamu okuzuula eby’okukola ku buzibu obw’enjawulo obubaawo mu bannaabwe. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekiraga okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyayogerwa?
answer_a: Mu kiseera ky’okwaniriza, omusomesa abuuza ku mateeka, era Rafael agamba: "Olina okutambulira munda mu kibiina so si kudduka."
answer_b: Mu budde bw'emmere, Daniela alya ku mmere ya munne, era akaaba. Ignacia, bw'amulaba nga akaaba, agenda eri omusomesa n'amugamba: "Munnange yeetaaga obuyambi."
answer_c: Mu biseera by’okuzannya , Matías yetegeleza Alejandro ng’azannyisa loole, oluvannyuma n’amusemberera, n’amuggyako eky’okuzannyanyisa n’agamba: “kiseera kyange, omusomesa yagambye tulina okugabana.”
answer_d: Mu biseera by'okukola, Leonor ne Sebastián basuula ebikondo by'emiti okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala mu kibiina. Agustín abasemberera n'abagamba: "Temusaanye kukola ekyo, muyinza okutukuba ebikondo."

question: Ku mutendera gw'abaana abato, abakugu mu by'enjigiriza beetaaga okukebera mu bulamu obwa bulijjo ekigendererwa kino okuva mu mutima gw'okunoonyereza ku butonde: "Okunnyonnyola ebimu ku bintu ebikulu ebikwata ku butonde bwe banoonyereza, gamba nga langi, obuwewufu, obunene, ebbugumu n'ebirala." question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina ekisooka ateekateeka omulimu gw’ekibinja okukolera ku bukugu bw’okunoonyereza awamu n’ekigendererwa ky’ekibiina: "Okutegeera obwongo n’omulimu gwabwo." Okutandika omulimu guno, agenda kuwa buli kibinja omutooke, omucungwa, n’omupeera, era agenda kubasaba okuwunyiriza, okulaba, okukwatako, n’okulega ku buli kibala. Nga twetegereza embeera eno waggulu, ku mirimu egiddako omusomesa gy’ayinza okuteekamu abayizi okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekigguddwaayo?
answer_a: Mu lupapula olulambika engeri z’ebibala eby’enjawulo, lamba eby’okuddamu ebibuuzo ebiyinza okuddibwamu nga tukozesa obutegeevu bwaffe: Kibala ki ekya kyenvu? Kibala ki ekiwooma? Kibala ki ekikakanyavu? Kibala ki ekiwunya bulungi?
answer_b: Ku lupapula omuli ebintu ebimanyiddwa okuyita mu birowoozo (ebiwoma/ebikaawa, obuwunga/omukaka, ebiwewuka/ebikakali, akaloosa akasanyusa/akaloosa akabi), ssa ebiriiso mu bibinja okusinziira ku bintu ebyo.
answer_c: Mu lupapula omuli ebifaananyi ebikiikirira buli kimu ku bumanyirivu, lamba eby’okuddamu ku bibuuzo bino: Bumanyirivu ki bwe wakozesezza okukiraba nti ebbugga lya kyenvu? Bwe ki ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti ppere lya matamiivu? Bwe ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti ekikuta ky’ebbugga kirungiirivu? Bwe ki ekyakuyambye okutegeera nti omucungwa guwoomerevu?
answer_d: Ku lupapula olulaga ebifaananyi by'ebibala bino nga kuliko empandiika enzirugavu erimu obwenyi obusanyufu n'obwenyi obunakuwavu, kozesa langi okuddamu ebibuuzo bino: Bw'abadde olya ekitundu ky'omucungwa, owulidde essanyu oba obunakuvu? Bw'obadde olaba langi y'e'nnanansi, ogisiimye oba togisiimye? Bw'obadde okwata ku kikuta ky'omupeera, owulidde essanyu oba obunakuvu? Bw'obadde owunya omucungwa, ogusiimye oba togusiimye?

question: Okukozesa omulimu ogw’okunoonyereza, omusomesa ayagala okwogera ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte. Okutuukiriza kino, alaga abayizi be eccupa erimu amazzi, amayinja, amafuta, n’omunnyo. Omusomesa alina eccupa eziwerako ezitegekeddwa nga zirimu ebintu bye bimu. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gyo gwonna gwandisobozesezza abayizi okuyiga ku nkola z’okwawula ebintu ebiri mu mugatte ate era ne bakulaakulanya obukugu bwabwe mu kukebera obutuufu bw’ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwa ssaayansi?
answer_a: Mu bibinja, basalewo tekiniki ki esinga okuba ey’omugaso okwawula omugatte era oluvannyuma bannyonnyole ensonga lwaki balondedde etekinki eyo.
answer_b: Nga bali mu bubiri bubiri, baawula omugatte nga bakozesa obukodyo bwe balaba nga butuufu, era balambulula okutuuka ku kigero ki obusobozi bwabwe okukola ekyo bwe bwali.
answer_c: Nga buli omu ku lwabwe, bawa ebirowoozo byabwe ebyasooka ku nkola ey’okugoberera, ne bateekawo enkola ey’awamu, oluvannyuma ne bagissa mu nkola.
answer_d: Kinnoomu kinnoomu, bagoberera enkola omusomesa gy’abalaze okwawula omutabulo ate oluvannyuma ne balaga tekinologiya ki ey’okwawula eyakozesebwa mu buli mbeera.

question: Omusomesa mu ssomero ly'abaana abato akola ku kiruubirirwa kino okuva mu mutendera gw'Olulimi: "Okutegeera, okuyita mu kuwuliriza n'obwegendereza, ebiri mu bitabo eby'okusoma n'ebitabu ebitali bya kusoma, okutegeera ensonga enkulu, okulaga by'osinga okwagala, okwogera ku bintu mu ngeri ennyangu, okubuuza ebikwata ku biri mu bitabo." Okukola okwekebejja kw'engeri omulimu gye gutambula, akabonero kano kateereddwaawo: Ategaera ebiri mu bitabo eby'okusoma. Ku mirimu egiddwa wano, gumu ku gyo gwe gusuubirwa okukozesebwa okufuna obukakafu ku mutendera ogw'okutuukiriza akabonero ako?
answer_a: Omusomesa alaga abaana ekifaananyi ekiri ku katabo k'olugero olwa "Akalulu n'Enkwawa" oluvannyuma n'ababuza kye balowooza ekitabo kino kigenda kwogeraako.
answer_b: Omusomesa ayita abaana okuzannya olugero "Empologoma n'Embeera" ate n'ababuuza essomo eriri mu lugero n'engeri zaalwo ze zituyigiriza.
answer_c: Omusomesa abalira abaana olugero olwa "Ekimuula Eky'embala" oluvannyuma n'abuuza abaana embala ki engeri z'ebimuula eky'embala kye kyasobola okutegeera ze yalina.
answer_d: Omusomesa asaba abaana okuzannya omuzannyo ogw’ekiggo ogwa "Toseka, Pepe" ate oluvannyuma ababuuza ekitundu kye baasinze okwagala mu lugero era n’abakubiriza okukola enkomerero endala ku lugero.

question: Omuyizi alina kuba ng’alina bumanyirivu ki okusobola okumanya ennyiriri eza hendecasyllabic?
answer_a: Tegeera enjawukana mu bigambo ebituukana.
answer_b: Okutegeera anaphora
answer_c: Okutegeera enjawulo wakati w'ebitontome ebitono eby'obuyiiya
answer_d: Tegeera ebitundu bya bayiti bisatu (tercet) n'ebitundu bya bayiti bina (quartet)

question: Omusomesa akola ku mutindo gw’okutegeera ebyo omuntu by’alowooza ng’asinziira ku kusoma olugero olumpi olugattiddwa wano: Empummula Omwaka ogujja famire yange etegeka okugenda ku mwezi. Maama yagambye nti nkyaleete mukwano gwange bwe mba njagala, okwewala okukoowa y’alowooza bw’atyo. Ekituufu kiri nti ssiri musanyufu nnyo, simanyi, sikyagalanga kuva ku planet eno nnyo, nsinga kwagala kulya nuddles ne ssausi wamu ne cheese. Wadde kiri kityo, mukwano gwange agamba nti yandyagadde nnyo okugenda, naye aŋŋamba nti yeetaaga bikini empya, bagamba nti abakazi abali ku mwezi balabika bulungi nnyo, naye sikikkiriza. Tunaasula ku wooteeri ya Armstrong era tunaatambulira ku Pullmanmoon (nsuubira nti erinaayo toilette). Nnaaleeta entangawuuzi. Catalina Yáñez Kibuzo ki omusomesa ky’ayinza okubuuza abayizi okukubiriza okusoma ku mutindo gw’okutegeera ebyo omuntu by’alowooza?
answer_a: Omutabani omukulu awulira atya ku lugendo olw’okudda ku mwezi?
answer_b: Olugendo lw’okuwummula ku mwezi lwandibadde luteekwa kubeera lulitya?
answer_c: Lwaki maama w'omutabani omukulu amugamba okuyita mukwano gwe?
answer_d: Omutwe gw'omulamwa atwala atya olugendo ku nkomerero y'olugero?

question: Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka gw’essomero, omusomesa w’abaana abato ayagala okukebera ekigendererwa kino okuva mu somo ly’Ennimi z’Obuyiiya: “Okulaga okwagala mu mawulire nga okuyita mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, gamba ng’okwogera nga omwana omuto, ebikolwa, okumwenya, n’ebirala.” Ngeri ki esinga okuba entuufu okukozesa okukebera embeera eno?
answer_a: Muwe abaana ffuluti ne kalirimba, mulinde era mulabe bwe bazikozesa.
answer_b: Leeta ebiseera ebitali bimu eri abaana, bikube era obireke babeere nabyo.
answer_c: Laga abaana ekintu ekireeta eddoboozi, oluvannyuma okibikke n'olugoye era obalindirire okukinoonya.
answer_d: Laga abaana ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo eby’ensolo ezifuyibwa mu maka basobole okukola ebivuga ebyazo.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekitongole eky’okutaano ayagala abayizi be okumanya, nga basinziira ku nteekateeka, ennyimba eziri mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo. Kiki ekikolwa ekisaanira abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino waggulu?
answer_a: Kola olukalala lw'ennyimba nga lwesigamiziddwa ku bubaka obuggyiddwa mu kubuuza.
answer_b: Noonya omutwe ogukwata ku nnyimba z'omu bibuga n'engeri gye zikolera ku bantu ba leero.
answer_c: Zzimba oba ovvuunule ennyimba ezimanyiddwa okuva mu lutalo lw'abavubuka olw'enjawulo olubakiikirira.
answer_d: Kola okunoonyereza ku baliraanwa bo era okuŋŋaanye amawulire agakwata ku ngeri z'ennyimba ezisinga okusiimwa mu kitundu kyammwe.

question: Ku mirimu gy’okukebera egikolebwa nga tebannazimba kifo we bagenda okuteeka ebintu byabwe, kiki ku bino wammanga ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okumanya omutindo gw’ebyo bye batuuseeko mu pulojekiti zaabwe?
answer_a: Basiima, nga bayita mu mboozi, obubonero bw’emirimu gyabwe, nga bannyonnyola olulimi olw’ebyobulabi olutegekeddwa.
answer_b: Bakebera emirimu gyabwe, nga balondoola engeri endowooza zaabwe, ebintu bye bakozesezza, n'olulimi olw'ebyobuwangwa bye baalonze bwe bikwatagana.
answer_c: Balaga ebintu ebikozesebwa mu by'obugubi eby'abakugu ab'omulembe guno era obigerageranye n'ebyo ebirondoolwa mu pulojekiti zaabwe.
answer_d: Bayiga ku pulojekiti z’okuteekawo ebintu ezikolebwa mu matendekero amalala era ne bazikenenula nga basinziira ku ndabika y’ennimi ezikozesebwa.

question: Mu mutima gw'emikwatagana egy'ekibalangulo n'okubala, omusomesa w'abaana abato akola omukolo gw'okuyiga ogw'engeri eno n'abaana: mu bibinja ebitono, abasaba okutwala emigogo ebiri egya pulasitiiki erimu omuwendo gwe gumu, okukola akapiira akanene n'ogumu n'obupiira obutono n'omulala. Oluvannyuma, abuuzza abaana: "Mulowooza wa weeri pulasitiiki ennyingi?". Nga tutunuulidde embeera eno, busobozi ki bw'okulowooza okw'ekibalangulo bwe bukuzibwa n'omukolo guno?
answer_a: Okubalilira
answer_b: Okukuuma obutonde bw’ensi
answer_c: Okuvunza
answer_d: Okukwatagana

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’omukaaga akola omulimu ku mitendera esatu era ateekateeka omukolo omuli abayizi okukola emitendera esatu ena nga emipanvu gyayo gye gi: Omutendera ogusooka: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 11 cm. Omutendera ogw’okubiri: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 9 cm. Omutendera ogw’okusatu: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 7 cm. Omutendera ogw’okuna: 12 cm, 5 cm ne 5 cm. Oluvannyuma, babasaba okwetegereza bye bazimbye n’okubigeraageranya ne bannaabwe okukakasa nti buli omu alaba ekintu kye kimu. Kiki ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’omukolo ogwo ogugambiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Gerageranya empuyi ssatu okusinziira ku buwanvu bw’embiriizi zaazo n’obunene bw’enz угол zaazo.
answer_b: Teebereza ku mbeera ezibeera zeetaagisa okuzimba e misambaggu.
answer_c: Weewaawo ebyo by’olabye ku mukwano oguli wakati w’enjuyi n’empeto z’omus المثلث (triangle).
answer_d: Kika kya busatu nga twesigama ku buwanvu bw’embiriizi zaabwo nga tunnyonnyola emitindo gy’okukisaawula.

question: Omusomesa omwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya, amalirizza omutwe ogw'enamba entuufu n'abayizi be era ayagala okukebera oba basobola okukola ebibuuzo ebitalina bimala mu namba ez'omugerageranyo. Ku bikolwa ebikozesebwa okukebera bino wammanga, kiki ekinaasobozesa omusomesa okufuna amawulire agakwata ku kino?
answer_a: Mennya obuwanvu bw’empuyi essatu ezilingana nga buli lumu lulina obuwanvu bwa 2.
answer_b: Balirira namba ezitaliimu mutonnyeze okuva wansi n'okusiimattuka waggulu
answer_c: Londa mizizi gy’ebikwatule ku lukalo lw’ennamba, ng’onyonyola enkola ekakasa.
answer_d: Manya obuwanvu bw'amagulu g'omusalaba ogw'ekika ekya isosceles ogwa layiti ogulina oluweweeso olupima 2/sqrt(2)

question: Ttiimu y’eby’enjigiriza mu kibiina ky’abaana abato etegeketege okunyweza okusiima enjawulo okusinziira ku kiruubirirwa kino ekikulu mu kumanya obutonde bw’eby’embeera z’abantu n’ennono: “Okutegeera ebikulu ebyabaddewo mu byafaayo byabwe bo ku bwabwe n’eby’amaka gaabwe, mu mbeera ezitali zimu.” Mu nkola zino wammanga, y’erina engeri gy’ekwatagana n’ekiruubirirwa ekyo?
answer_a: Kukola ngabulo ku buli maka g'omwana, ng'oyanjula abantu baamu.
answer_b: Teekamu ebintu ebikozesebwa mu maka omuli ebikozesebwa mu kufumba n’ebintu omuterekebwa ebintu abaana bye bakozesa mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo.
answer_c: Tegeka ebifo by'okukolera omulimu omwana gy'akiikirira ebintu eby'enjawulo by'akola n'ab'omu maka ge.
answer_d: Muteeketeeke akadde k'omukolo ogw'ekibiina omwana yenna lw'ayogera ku mulimu gw'omuntu omu mu famire yaabwe.

question: Okusinziira ku kigendererwa kino: "Soma pulaani ennyangu ez'ebitundu by'obulamu bwo, ng'okozesa ebifo eby'enjawulo n'ebika by'ebifo ebiraga obunene bwabyo," bikorwa ki ebisaana okukozesebwa okukekeera omwana mu mwaka ogw'okubiri?
answer_a: Loba ekiifananyi ekiraga enteekateeka y'ekisenge ky'eklassi.
answer_b: Tegeera amakulu g'obubonero obuli ku pulaani y'ekibuga
answer_c: Lambulula ebifo we bisangibwa ku maapu eno.
answer_d: Okakasa endagiriro z'obubonero obuweereddwa ku katimba.

question: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’omunaana, ku nkomerero y’essomo, agenda kukebera obusobozi bw’abayizi be okusunsula ensibuko z’ebyamawulire, ng’asinziira ku bwesigwa bwazo. Okukola kino, ategeka akatabo akamuyamba era akoze n’ebipimo bino: 1. Balaga omuntu eyawandiise ebyo. 2. Bannyonnyola mu bufunze gye byaggyiddwa oba embeera ebyo we byaggyiddwa. Mu bipimo bino ebiri wammanga, ekirala kiki ekikwatagana n’ebyo era ekigya kuyamba okumaliriza akatabo kano?
answer_a: Balaga ekika ky'ensibuko y'ebyo bye bakozesezza.
answer_b: Bakaayana ku makulu g'ebyawandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Bategeera ekyo ekigendererwa ekiri mu nsibuko y'ebyo bye basoma.
answer_d: Bakebera obutuufu bw'ebyo ebiri mu ssaabu y'ebyanjuliziddwa.

question: Omusomesa mu kibiina ky'abaana abato atendeka abaana be ku kigendererwa kino: "Okugeraageranya engeri ebintu bya tekinologiya gye bikolebwamu, omugaso gwabyo, n'engeri gye bigasa mu ngeri ez'enjawulo." Okukola kino, omusomesa asooka n'aleeta ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'enjawulo, ng'abuuza abaana kye babimanyiiko nga tannaba kubannyonnyola mugaso gwabyo. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abasaba okunoonyereza, okwetegereza, n'okunnyonnyola ebintu bya tekinologiya eby'enjawulo ebikozesebwa awaka: amasimu, obusawo bw'enviiri, ebyuma by'okukaliza enviiri, essaawa, leediyo, mbooki, n'ebirala. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa agabanya abaana mu bibinja era n'abalagira okukungaanya ebintu bya tekinologiya, nga bajjukira bye baalabye. Ekimu ku bibinja kikungaanya ebintu mu ngeri etali ntegeerekeka. Bwe babuuziddwa, abalimu bagamba nti tebamanyi ngeri gye bakikolamu. Kukola ki omusomesa ky'asaanidde okukola okwongera okunyweza okuyiga mu kibiinja kino?
answer_a: Omusomesa ajja n’abalaga ensobi gye bakoze. Abaalaga engeri y’okugattamu ebintu n’annyonnyola lwaki kikolebwa bwe kityo, oluvannyuma n’abalagira okugenda mu maaso nga bagoberera ekyokulabirako.
answer_b: Omusomesa ababuuza: Mujjukira bye twalaba? Twayogera ku ki? Buli kimu ku bino kigendererwa ki? Kati, muyinza okubigattika mutya? Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde okubigattika n'abalondoola.
answer_c: Omusomesa ajja gyebali n’abagamba nti bakola bulungi, naye balina okwetegereza engeri ebintu gye bifaanana okusobola okubigattulula mu biti byabyo mu ngeri entuufu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde obulala okuddamu okugezaako.
answer_d: Omusomesa agamba nti baayogera ku mirimu gya buli kintu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa alaga nti ebimu bikozesebwa mu ffumbiro, ebirala mu kaabuyonjo, n'ebirala bya kukoleramu. Oluvannyuma, omusomesa abawa obudde okubigattulula.

question: Omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okutaano, mu kitundu eky'Ebipimo by'ebintu eby'omulembe ogw'omulembe guno, ateesa eri abayizi okukola empaka ku by'okuggwaawo kw'ebintu mu bwangu n'enkolagana yakwo n'obugunjufu. Oluvannyuma lw'ebiva mu mpaka, akiraba nti ekibinja ky'abayizi kigatta endowooza y'okuggwaawo kw'ebintu mu bwangu n'omutindo gw'ebintu. Nga tuloowoza ku mutendera gw'abayizi, kwe kulaga okunnyonnyola kw'omusomesa okuyinza okuyamba okwolesa endowooza eno?
answer_a: Kwe kusalawo oba okuteekateeka enkomerero y’obulamu obugasa obw’ekintu oba tekinologiya, era tekikwatagana na mutindo gwakyo, nga bwe kiba nga waliwo ekintu ekisinga obukugu oba ekirina emirimu emipya kiyisiddwa ku katale.
answer_b: Kwe kusalawo, mu kiseera eky'okukola ebintu, omuntu okumanya ebbanga ekintu kyekinaamala, okukikakasa nti kizzibwa buggya ku nkomerero y'ekiseera ekyo. Kikwatagana n'omutindo ng'ekintu kitandise okubaako obuzibu n'okwonooneka oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera.
answer_c: Ggwe lwe kiseera ebalirirwa omukugu akola ebintu ng’akola ekintu, okukiggwaako omugaso n’okulekeraawo okukozesebwa, nga tekyonoonye mutindo gwakyo, nga bwe kiba nga waliwo ekintu ekirala ekisingako obulungi ekifulumiziddwa ku katale abantu ne bakikyusa n’ekyo kye balina.
answer_d: Kuba kusalawo okutuukirizibwa mu ngeri ezitali zimu, okugeza, olw’obutabaawo bw’ebitundutundu eby’ekiyungirizo oba obwetaavu bw’okugula ekintu ekipya ekijja mu kifo ky’ekyo, okukyuka kw’ebintu okwa bulijjo n’okwegomba kw’abantu okukyusa bye balina, nga tekikwatagana na mutindo gwabyo

question:
Omusomesa w'ekibiina ky'abali mu Siniya emu mu ssomero eggattule abagamba okukola omulimu oguyitibwa "Emprendemás." Mu mulimu guno, abayizi balina okutandikawo kkampuni ewaayo obuweereza okugonjoola obwetaavu bw'ekitundu ky'abantu ekimu. Abayizi bwe baleeta ebirowoozo byabwe nga bannyonnyola obwetaavu bwe bagenda okugonjoola n'obuweereza bwe bagenda okuwaayo, omusomesa akiraba nti ttiimu ezimu tezisobola kutegeera kitundu ky'abantu obuweereza bwe bugenda okutuukirira.
Kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okuteesa abayizi basobole okumanya ekitundu ky'abantu obuweereza bwe baagala okuwaayo kye bugenda okutuukirira?
answer_a: Saba abayizi okwekenneenya empisa z'abantu be baazuulamu obwetaavu, balyoke bategeere obubaka, oluvannyuma bakole maapu y'okutegeera okumanya kye baagala.
answer_b: Lagiriza ttiimu okulaba vidiyo eraga obuweereza obuweebwa abavuganyi era bategeere ekika ky'abantu be baweereza, oluvannyuma babigeregeranye n'abo abayinza okukozesa ebintu byabwe.
answer_c: Lagiriza ttiimu okunoonyereza ku bitundu by’abantu ebyo mpaka ze ziwa obuweereza obufaanana n’obwezo ze zitegeka, basobole okubyekenneenya era balondoolole enjawulo, nga bategeka omugaso gw’obuweereza bwe bawaayo.
answer_d: Saba abayizi bakole era baweereze ebibuuzo ku mikutu gy'enternet eri abantu ab'enjawulo nga bababuza oba bandikozesezza omulimu gwe balagira, era bakuŋŋaanye ebifaanaanyi okuva eri abo abazzeemu, gamba ng'emyaka, omusaala, omulimu, eggwanga, n'ekikula.

question: Ku mirimu gy'eby'obuwangwa egiddirira, kkirina ewa omwana omukisa omungi okukulaakulanya ekitone kye eky'obuyiiya?
answer_a: Okukuba langi y'amazzi ku ndabirwamu ya mandala
answer_b: Okukozesa empapula ez’enjawulo okukola ebifaananyi nga ozizinga.
answer_c: Okukola omuti ogulabika okuva mu ssaluuni ng’okozesa ebbumba.
answer_d: Okukuba empapula ez'ebala mu ndabirwamu ez'enjawulo

question:
Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসরুম muno:
Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka, abayizi mu ssomero basabwa okuwa emboozi ya ddakiika 2 ku luwummula lwabwe olw’ekyeya. Paula, omuwala omuswavu era omutonotono, alindirira omukisa gwe okwogera. Bw’akola bw’atyo, omutima gwe gutandika okukuba nnyo, ebiganja bye bitandika okutuuyuka n’olubuto lwe lumuluma. Omusomesa we bw’amuyita mu maaso era Paula n’atandika okwogera, afuna obuzibu okujjukira ky’ayagala okwogera n’emikono gye gitandika okukankana.
Mu mbeera eweereddwa, kiki ekisinga okutegeerekeka okuva mu birowoozo bya Paula n’enneeyisa ye?
answer_a: Ekikulukuto kye eky’enneewulira kyakugiddwa.
answer_b: Akaziba ke akamuziyiza okuyiga kakkakkiddwa.
answer_c: Munyavu okwogera ku luwummula lwe.
answer_d: Oboolyawo ayinza okuba ng’ayolekagana n’ekizibu ekimu.

question: Okusinziira ku Bowlby's theory, ki ku bino wammanga ekikwatagana n'empisa y'omukwano (attachment)?
answer_a: Nkola emala ebbanga okutuusa emyaka egy’obuto.
answer_b: Ggwe busibiro obuteekwa okuba obunywevu era obw’omugattako okusobola okukakasa enkulaakulana ennungi
answer_c: Gwe muguwa ogusalawo enkolagana yonna ey’omutima mu bulamu n’enkulaakulana.
answer_d: Gwe mukwano omubereberye omwana omuto gw’alina ne nnyina era teguyinza kuddibwamu muntu mulala.
